title: 正德八年河南鄉試錄
text:
河南鄉試錄序
我
太祖高皇帝建元洪武之年始定
河洛謂君天下非中州不可
夏四月躬率禁兵泛舟江淮
遡河入汴將擇而居之既而
鼎定金陵不果至而二年三
===
年春免租之
詔毋及茲地九年秋社感侍臣言
猶勤山川與古今人物之思
聖心之拳拳中州者如此
太宗文皇帝北都幽薊亦惟于是
供億之省材勇之惜墟澤之
布必先焉
punctuated:
河南鄉試錄序

我太祖高皇帝建元洪武之年，始定河洛，謂君天下非中州不可。夏四月，躬率禁兵，泛舟江淮，遡河入汴，將擇而居之。既而鼎定金陵，不果至，而二年、三年春免租之詔毋及茲地。九年秋社，感侍臣言，猶勤山川與古今人物之思。聖心之拳拳中州者如此。

太宗文皇帝北都幽薊，亦惟于是，供億之省、材勇之惜、墟澤之布，必先焉。
translation_en:
Preface to the Record of the Henan Provincial Examination

In the year when our Emperor Taizu Gao inaugurated the Hongwu reign, he first pacified the He–Luo region. He declared that ruling All under Heaven required a seat in the Central Plain. In the fourth month, in summer, he personally led the imperial guards, traveling by boat along the Yangzi and Huai rivers and upstream along the Yellow River into Bian, intending to choose a site and reside there. Subsequently, he established his capital at Jinling and did not ultimately arrive. Yet the spring edicts remitting land taxes in the second and third years did not extend to this region [?]. At the autumn sacrifice to the soil god in the ninth year [?], moved by the words of an attendant minister, he still gave earnest thought to its mountains and rivers and its notable people, past and present. Such was the imperial heart’s devoted concern for the Central Plain.

Emperor Taizong Wen established his northern capital in the You–Ji region. He too invariably gave this region priority in reducing requisitions for supplies, cherishing talented and courageous men, and bestowing beneficence [?].

title: 正德八年河南鄉試錄
text:
列聖相承世積凞洽百四十餘年
士生其間沾被教養於兩畿
爲宻邇視諸藩爲獨厚激昂
奮發得之相觀令日之人才
殆非
國初比矣科目之所取者其能
盡乎令
===
聖天子即位之八年八月天下當
大比河南廵按監察御史陸
〔鰲〕謹循舊典諭于藩臬預聘
〔賢〕等以柄校文比至如期入
院〔鰲〕職在監臨謂〔賢〕偕學正
王〔夔〕職考試學正鄧〔鏞〕教
諭楊〔澤〕鄒〔府〕林〔寬〕黄〔永〕椿〔桑〕
punctuated:
列聖相承，世積凞洽百四十餘年。士生其間，沾被教養，於兩畿爲宻邇，視諸藩爲獨厚；激昂奮發，得之相觀。令日之人才，殆非國初比矣。科目之所取者，其能盡乎？令聖天子即位之八年八月，天下當大比。
河南廵按監察御史陸〔鰲〕謹循舊典，諭于藩臬，預聘〔賢〕等以柄校文。比至，如期入院。〔鰲〕職在監臨，謂〔賢〕偕學正王〔夔〕職考試，學正鄧〔鏞〕、教諭楊〔澤〕、鄒〔府〕、林〔寬〕、黄〔永〕、椿〔桑〕
translation_en:
Successive sage emperors have inherited the throne, accumulating prosperity and harmony for more than 140 years. Scholars born during this period have benefited from instruction and nurture. Close to the two metropolitan regions, they have enjoyed exceptional advantages compared with those in the other provinces; they have gained inspiration and resolve by observing one another. The men of talent today [?] can scarcely be compared with those at the dynasty’s founding. Can those selected through the examinations encompass them all? In the eighth month of the eighth year after the present [?] sagely Son of Heaven ascended the throne, the triennial examinations were due throughout the realm.
Lu Ao, Regional Inspector of Henan and Investigating Censor, respectfully followed established precedent and notified the provincial administration and surveillance commissions, arranging in advance to invite Xian and others to direct the evaluation of examination essays. Upon arriving, they entered the examination compound at the appointed time. Ao served as Supervising Official. He designated Xian, together with Wang Kui, an Instructor, to serve as Examiners; Deng Yong, an Instructor, and Yang Ze, Zou Fu, Lin Kuan, Huang Yong, and Chun Sang [?], all Instructors …

title: 正德八年河南鄉試錄
text:
濟邦訓導秦〔錡〕職同考試若
提調則右布政使楊〔子器〕左
叅政何〔孟春〕監試則按察使
陳〔璘〕副使沙〔鵬〕是職其他執
事皆出懋簡各有專責簾內
外惟公惟慎申飭備至乃合
提學僉事劉〔玉〕所簡士三試
之卷冊浩穰展分奎聚文辭
===
典麗玉映珠聯盛哉河南之
士之文也而
制額限焉拆卷錄名定八十人
而止賢於
國初額數計之固有以知今日
中州人才之盛于昔也於是
punctuated: 濟邦、訓導秦〔錡〕職同考試。若提調，則右布政使楊〔子器〕、左叅政何〔孟春〕；監試，則按察使陳〔璘〕、副使沙〔鵬〕是職。其他執事皆出懋簡，各有專責。簾內外惟公惟慎，申飭備至。乃合提學僉事劉〔玉〕所簡士，三試之。卷冊浩穰，展分奎聚，文辭典麗，玉映珠聯。盛哉，河南之士之文也！而制額限焉，拆卷錄名，定八十人而止。賢於國初額數計之，固有以知今日中州人才之盛于昔也。於是
translation_en:
…Jibang, and Assistant Instructor Qin Qi served as Associate Examiners. The Proctors were Right Provincial Administration Commissioner Yang Ziqi and Left Administration Vice Commissioner He Mengchun; examination supervision was entrusted to Provincial Surveillance Commissioner Chen Lin and Surveillance Vice Commissioner Sha Peng. All other functionaries were carefully selected, each with specific responsibilities. Both inside and outside the examination curtain, fairness and care alone were to govern; instructions and admonitions were thorough in every respect.
They then assembled the scholars selected by Liu Yu, Surveillance Assistant Commissioner for Education, and examined them in three sessions. The examination scripts were vast in number; as they were opened and distributed, literary brilliance gathered [?]. Their language was classical and elegant, like gleaming jade and linked pearls. How splendid were the writings of Henan’s scholars! Yet the imperially prescribed quota imposed a limit: the scripts were unsealed and the names recorded, and the selection stopped at eighty men. Comparing this with the quota at the founding of the dynasty, I, Xian, can indeed see that the Central Plain’s wealth of talent today surpasses that of former times. Thereupon…

title: 正德八年河南鄉試錄
text:
錄其在前列者文二十篇餘
文雖美不盡錄錄成當獻諸
上而賢當序諸首簡或曰河南天
地之中古多帝王立國之地
聖賢發跡之區虞夏前世遠
姑弗論詩書所稱若周召之
所治申甫之所生孔孟之所
===
遊萬世一日古不既盛矣乎
秦漢而下士之以學行名業
顯者未易僂數漢若賈誼有
王佐才唐若韓愈推文章大
家宋若程氏兄弟為道學真
儒不亦其中之盛者乎今科
目所取固文也於古里選之
punctuated: 錄其在前列者文二十篇，餘文雖美，不盡錄。錄成，當獻諸上，而賢當序諸首簡。或曰：「河南，天地之中，古多帝王立國之地、聖賢發跡之區。虞夏前，世遠，姑弗論。詩書所稱，若周召之所治、申甫之所生、孔孟之所遊，萬世一日，古不既盛矣乎？秦漢而下，士之以學行名業顯者，未易僂數。漢若賈誼有王佐才，唐若韓愈推文章大家，宋若程氏兄弟為道學真儒，不亦其中之盛者乎？今科目所取固文也，於古里選之
translation_en:
…Twenty essays by those ranked foremost were selected for inclusion. Though the remaining essays were fine, they could not all be included. Once the record was completed, it was to be presented to His Majesty, and I, Xian, was to write a preface for its opening leaves.
Someone said: “Henan lies at the center of Heaven and Earth. Since antiquity, it has contained many places where emperors and kings established their states, and regions where sages and worthies first rose to prominence. The time before Yu and Xia is remote; let us leave it aside. As for the places mentioned in the Book of Odes and the Book of Documents—those governed by the dukes of Zhou and Shao, those where Shen and Fu were born, and those through which Kongzi and Mengzi traveled—their renown endures through ten thousand generations as though but a single day. Was its flourishing in antiquity not already great? From the Qin and Han onward, the scholars distinguished for learning, conduct, reputation, and achievement cannot readily be counted on one’s fingers. In the Han, Jia Yi possessed the talent to assist a king; in the Tang, Han Yu was acclaimed as a great master of prose; in the Song, the Cheng brothers were true Confucian scholars of the Learning of the Way. Were these not among its most outstanding figures? What the examinations select today is, to be sure, literary composition. Compared with the ancient method of selection through local communities…”

title: 正德八年河南鄉試錄
text:
法異然有司舍是亦將何所
據依貫誼之通達國體蓋自
其書見之韓愈之第號龍虎
榜重其文也程顥氏試論一
出識者知其有聖賢之學然
則謂科目不足得人文不足
取士也可乎伏惟
===
國家養士學校無非先王三物
之教科目之所取者在是因
言探心即文占行古今之所
不能廢也中州自宋南渡陷
沒金元我
朝始復文明之舊今日之盛豈
非
punctuated: 法異，然有司舍是，亦將何所據依？貫誼之通達國體，蓋自其書見之。韓愈之第，號龍虎榜，重其文也。程顥氏試論一出，識者知其有聖賢之學。然則謂科目不足得人、文不足取士也，可乎？伏惟國家養士學校，無非先王三物之教。科目之所取者在是，因言探心，即文占行，古今之所不能廢也。中州自宋南渡，陷沒金元，我朝始復文明之舊。今日之盛，豈非
translation_en: …differs from that method. Yet if the responsible officials abandoned this, what else could they rely upon? Jia Yi’s [?; transcribed as 貫誼] thorough understanding of the essentials of government can be seen in his writings. The list on which Han Yu passed was called the “Dragon and Tiger List,” such was the esteem accorded his writing. As soon as Cheng Hao’s examination discourse appeared, discerning readers knew that he possessed the learning of the sages and worthies. Can one then say that the examination system cannot find capable men, or that writing cannot serve to select scholars? I humbly submit that the state nurtures scholars in its schools entirely through the former kings’ teaching of the three categories. These are what the examinations seek to select for. To probe the mind through words and judge conduct through writing is something that neither antiquity nor the present can dispense with. After the Song court moved south, the Central Plain fell under Jin and Yuan rule; only under our dynasty was its former cultural flourishing restored. Surely today’s prosperity is due to…

title: 正德八年河南鄉試錄
text:
祖宗之發顧而深眷者有以再造
之耶時鎮守太監王〔宏〕自薊
移鎮省城實重是舉巡撫左
副都御史鄧〔璋〕行部方岳之
餘念當試期遂預回鎮稽據
品式凡冝作興視昔加備而
清軍監察御史許〔完〕又奉
===
命當至右叅政胡〔玥〕臧〔鳳〕劉〔顯〕副
使李〔璽〕文〔皓〕左叅議董〔鋭〕右
叅議石〔昭〕僉事陳〔和〕王〔玹〕何
〔正〕王〔納〕〔誨〕馮〔相〕劉〔文〕〔寵〕劉〔澤〕
甯〔河〕曾〔大〕〔顯〕相與賛襄厥事
務爲
朝廷得人以稱今日之盛其用
punctuated: 祖宗之發顧而深眷者，有以再造之耶？時鎮守太監王〔宏〕自薊移鎮省城，實重是舉。巡撫左副都御史鄧〔璋〕行部方岳之餘，念當試期，遂預回鎮，稽據品式，凡冝作興，視昔加備。而清軍監察御史許〔完〕又奉命當至。右叅政胡〔玥〕、臧〔鳳〕、劉〔顯〕，副使李〔璽〕、文〔皓〕，左叅議董〔鋭〕，右叅議石〔昭〕，僉事陳〔和〕、王〔玹〕、何〔正〕、王〔納〕〔誨〕、馮〔相〕、劉〔文〕〔寵〕、劉〔澤〕、甯〔河〕、曾〔大〕〔顯〕，相與賛襄厥事，務爲朝廷得人，以稱今日之盛。其用
translation_en: …was it not the attention [?] and profound solicitude of the imperial ancestors that brought about this renewal? At that time, Wang Hong, the eunuch grand defender, transferred his station from Ji to the provincial capital and attached great importance to this examination. Deng Zhang, Grand Coordinator and Left Vice Censor-in-Chief, mindful that the examination season was approaching, returned to his headquarters in advance after touring the region. He consulted the prescribed standards and procedures, and preparations for everything that ought to be promoted were more thorough than before. Xu Wan, the Investigating Censor charged with inspecting military registers, was also expected to arrive under imperial orders. Hu Yue, Zang Feng, and Liu Xian, Right Administration Vice Commissioners; Li Xi and Wen Hao, Surveillance Vice Commissioners; Dong Rui, Left Administration Assistant Commissioner; Shi Zhao, Right Administration Assistant Commissioner; and Chen He, Wang Xuan, He Zheng, Wang Nahui, Feng Xiang, Liu Wenchong, Liu Ze, Ning He, and Zeng Daxian, Surveillance Assistant Commissioners, all worked together to assist in the undertaking. They strove to obtain worthy men for the imperial court, commensurate with the flourishing conditions of the present day. Their efforts…

title: 正德八年河南鄉試錄
text:
心均也抑〔賢〕於是重有感焉
辛未壬申之歲盜發畿甸軼
河南北戎馬生郊氛厲徧野
使賓賢之期弗適平盜之後
八郡士皇皇焉行畏豺狼居
苦荊棘安得從容暇豫旅集
藝塲抽閟騁妍以決進取而
===
爲之鎮廵者方身任安危勞
精役知帷幄間藩臬重臣亦
皆躍馬總干奔命行陣諸有
司憂切扞防安得曠月相從
以畢意於鉛槧然則今日衣
冠慶會風恬日熙寔
上天眷命
punctuated: 心均也。抑〔賢〕於是重有感焉：辛未、壬申之歲，盜發畿甸，軼河南北，戎馬生郊，氛厲徧野。使賓賢之期弗適平盜之後，八郡士皇皇焉，行畏豺狼，居苦荊棘，安得從容暇豫，旅集藝塲，抽閟騁妍，以決進取？而爲之鎮廵者，方身任安危，勞精役知帷幄間；藩臬重臣亦皆躍馬總干，奔命行陣；諸有司憂切扞防，安得曠月相從，以畢意於鉛槧？然則今日衣冠慶會，風恬日熙，寔上天眷命
translation_en: …their dedication is the same. Yet I, Xian 〔賢〕, find further cause for reflection here. In the xinwei and renshen years [1511 and 1512], bandits arose in the metropolitan region and swept across the lands north and south of the Yellow River. Warhorses appeared in the outskirts, and a baleful atmosphere spread throughout the countryside. Had the occasion for honoring worthy men not fallen after the suppression of the bandits, the scholars of the eight prefectures would have been distraught: fearing jackals and wolves when traveling, suffering amid thorns and brambles at home. How could they have enjoyed the ease and leisure to assemble at the examination grounds, draw forth their hidden talents, display their accomplishments, and contend for advancement? The regional commanders and grand coordinators were then personally bearing responsibility for security and danger, taxing their energies and intellects in their command tents. The high officials of the Provincial Administration and Surveillance Commissions likewise mounted their horses and took up shields, hastening to carry out orders among the battle ranks. The various local authorities were anxiously occupied with defense. How could they have spent a whole month together, devoting their full attention to the work of brush and tablet? Thus, today’s joyous gathering of scholars and officials, with winds calm and sunshine warm, truly results from Heaven’s favor and its bestowal of the mandate upon …

title: 正德八年河南鄉試錄
text:
皇上而特祐才賢使輔
至治于方來也夫豈偶哉今在選
之士極譪譪濟濟之盛行將
上春官對
大廷布列有位尚相與勉之所
以保豐持泰億萬斯年以酬
聖顧荅
===
天眷者是科當必有人焉踵洛出
而有嶽降吾有望於是科得
人之稱盛矣
直隷順德府儒學教授陸賢
謹序
punctuated:
皇上，而特祐才賢，使輔至治于方來也，夫豈偶哉！今在選之士，極譪譪濟濟之盛，行將上春官，對大廷，布列有位，尚相與勉之。所以保豐持泰，億萬斯年，以酬聖顧、荅天眷者，是科當必有人焉。踵洛出而有嶽降，吾有望於是科得人之稱盛矣。
直隷順德府儒學教授陸賢謹序。
translation_en:
…His Majesty, and specially protects talented and worthy men so that they may assist in bringing about consummate government in the years ahead. Could this possibly be mere chance? The men now selected form a splendid gathering of abundant talent and dignity. Soon they will proceed to the Ministry of Rites, respond to questions at the imperial court, and take their places in official posts. May they encourage one another in their efforts. Among those selected in this examination there must surely be men who will preserve prosperity and sustain peace for countless years, thereby repaying the Emperor’s gracious regard and answering Heaven’s favor. Following the auspicious emergence from the Luo River, the sacred mountains have sent down worthy men. I look to this examination to win great acclaim for obtaining men of talent.
Preface respectfully composed by Lu Xian, Professor of the Confucian School of Shunde Prefecture, in the directly administered territory.

title: 正德八年河南鄉試錄
text:
正德八年河南鄉試
監臨官
巡按河南監察御史陸鼇〔鎮卿直隸吳江縣人　壬戌進士〕
提調官
河南等處承宣布政使司右布政使楊子器〔名父浙江慈谿縣人　丁未進士〕
河南等處承宣布政使司左參政何孟春〔子元湖廣郴州人　癸丑進士〕
監試官
河南等處提刑按察司按察使陳璘〔邦瑞山西陽曲縣人　癸丑進士〕
河南等處提刑按察司副使沙鵬〔騰霄直隸江都縣人　己未進士〕
===
考試官
直隸順德府儒學教授陸賢〔淵之湖廣嘉魚縣人　丙午貢士〕
湖廣郴州儒學學正王學夔〔一卿江西安福縣人　丁卯貢士〕
同考試官
直隸淮安府邳州儒學學正鄧鏞〔朝器江西豐城縣人　丁卯貢士〕
山西平陽府洪洞縣儒學教諭楊澤〔天恩陝西西安左衞人　庚午貢士〕
湖廣武昌府興國州大冶縣儒學教諭鄒府〔孔脩廣東廣州左衞人　丁卯貢士〕
江西瑞州府高安縣儒學教諭林寬〔仁量福建懷安縣人　丁卯貢士〕
陝西西安府乾州武功縣儒學教諭黃永椿〔壽卿直隸江都縣人　庚午貢士〕
punctuated:
正德八年河南鄉試。

監臨官：巡按河南監察御史陸鼇〔鎮卿，直隸吳江縣人，壬戌進士〕。

提調官：河南等處承宣布政使司右布政使楊子器〔名父，浙江慈谿縣人，丁未進士〕。河南等處承宣布政使司左參政何孟春〔子元，湖廣郴州人，癸丑進士〕。

監試官：河南等處提刑按察司按察使陳璘〔邦瑞，山西陽曲縣人，癸丑進士〕。河南等處提刑按察司副使沙鵬〔騰霄，直隸江都縣人，己未進士〕。

考試官：直隸順德府儒學教授陸賢〔淵之，湖廣嘉魚縣人，丙午貢士〕。湖廣郴州儒學學正王學夔〔一卿，江西安福縣人，丁卯貢士〕。

title: 正德八年河南鄉試錄
text:
第壹場
四書
富與貴是人之所欲也不以其道得之不
處也貧與賤是人之所惡也不以其
道得之不去也
苟不固聰明聖知達天德者其孰能知之
聖人治天下使有菽粟如水火菽粟如水
火而民焉有不仁者乎
易
初六有孚比之无咎有孚盈缶終來有他
===
吉
王假有家交相愛也
謙也者致恭以存其位者也
往者屈也來者信也屈信相感而利生焉
書
肆類于上帝禋于六宗望于山川徧于羣
神
欽厥止率乃祖攸行
punctuated:
第壹場

四書

富與貴，是人之所欲也；不以其道得之，不處也。貧與賤，是人之所惡也；不以其道得之，不去也。

苟不固聰明聖知達天德者，其孰能知之？

聖人治天下，使有菽粟如水火。菽粟如水火，而民焉有不仁者乎？

易

初六：有孚，比之，无咎。有孚盈缶，終來有他吉。

王假有家，交相愛也。

謙也者，致恭以存其位者也。

往者，屈也；來者，信也。屈信相感，而利生焉。

書

肆類于上帝，禋于六宗，望于山川，徧于羣神。

欽厥止，率乃祖攸行，
translation_en:
First Session

Four Books

“Wealth and high rank are what people desire. If they cannot be obtained by the proper way, one does not abide in them. Poverty and low station are what people dislike. If they have come upon one otherwise than by the proper way, one does not abandon them.”

“Unless one is truly [?] perceptive, sagely, and wise, comprehending Heaven’s virtue, who could understand this?”

“When a sage governs All under Heaven, he makes beans and grain as plentiful as water and fire. With beans and grain as plentiful as water and fire, how could any among the people fail to be benevolent?”

Book of Changes

“Six in the first place: With sincerity, join with others, and there will be no blame. With sincerity filling an earthen vessel, unexpected good fortune will come in the end.”

“‘The king comes to possess a family’ means that its members love one another.”

“Humility means showing the utmost reverence in order to preserve one’s position.”

“What departs contracts; what comes extends. Contraction and extension act upon each other, and benefit arises from them.”

Book of Documents

“Thereupon he offered the lei sacrifice to the Lord on High, made purified offerings to the Six Honored Powers, offered sacrifices from afar to the mountains and rivers, and extended his worship to the multitude of spirits.”

“Reverently attend to where you abide, and follow the conduct of your forebears …”

title: 正德八年河南鄉試錄

爾身克正罔敢弗正民心罔中惟爾之中

公
衆維魚矣實維豐年旐維旟矣室家溱溱
鳳凰鳴矣于彼高岡梧桐生矣于彼朝陽
菶菶萋萋雝雝喈喈君子之車既庶
且多君子之馬既閑且馳

楚子入陳〔宣公十有一年〕楚子圍鄭　晉
荀林父帥師及楚子戰于邲晉師敗
績〔俱宣公十有二年〕晉欒書帥師救
鄭〔成公六年〕遂滅偪陽〔襄公十年〕
齊侯使國佐如師　及國佐盟于袁婁〔成〕
punctuated:
是訓是行，以近天子之光。爾身克正，罔敢弗正；民心罔中，惟爾之中。

詩
二之日其同，載纘武功。言私其豵，獻豜于公。衆維魚矣，實維豐年；旐維旟矣，室家溱溱。鳳凰鳴矣，于彼高岡；梧桐生矣，于彼朝陽。菶菶萋萋，雝雝喈喈。君子之車，既庶且多；君子之馬，既閑且馳。休矣皇考，以保明其身。

春秋
諸侯遂救許〔僖公六年〕。諸侯遂圍許〔僖公二十有八年〕。楚子入陳〔宣公十有一年〕。楚子圍鄭，晉荀林父帥師及楚子戰于邲，晉師敗績〔俱宣公十有二年〕。晉欒書帥師救鄭〔成公六年〕。遂滅偪陽〔襄公十年〕。齊侯使國佐如師，及國佐盟于袁婁〔成〕
translation_en:
…Follow these instructions and put them into practice, thereby drawing near to the radiance of the Son of Heaven. If your own person is upright, none will dare to be otherwise; the people’s hearts have no fixed mean, but take your mean as their own.

Book of Odes
In the days of the second month, they assemble and carry on their martial work. They keep the young boars for themselves and present the full-grown boars to their lord.
The multitude are indeed fish: truly a sign of a plentiful year. The tortoise-and-serpent and falcon banners fly; households are numerous and flourishing.
The phoenixes call upon that high ridge; the parasol trees grow upon its sunward slope. Luxuriant and abundant is their foliage; harmonious and melodious are the calls. The lord’s carriages are many and plentiful; the lord’s horses are well trained and swift.
Glorious was the august deceased father, who preserved and made illustrious his person.

Spring and Autumn Annals
The feudal lords thereupon went to the rescue of Xu. 〔Sixth year of Duke Xi.〕 The feudal lords thereupon besieged Xu. 〔Twenty-eighth year of Duke Xi.〕
The Viscount of Chu entered Chen. 〔Eleventh year of Duke Xuan.〕 The Viscount of Chu besieged Zheng. Xun Linfu of Jin led an army into battle against the Viscount of Chu at Bi; the Jin army suffered a crushing defeat. 〔Both in the twelfth year of Duke Xuan.〕 Luan Shu of Jin led an army to rescue Zheng. 〔Sixth year of Duke Cheng.〕 Thereupon they destroyed Biyang. 〔Tenth year of Duke Xiang.〕
The Marquis of Qi sent Guo Zuo to the army. A covenant was concluded with Guo Zuo at Yuanlou. 〔Duke Cheng …〕

title: 正德八年河南鄉試錄
text:
〔公二年〕
突歸于鄭　鄭忽出奔衛〔僖桓公十有〕
〔年〕公伐齊納糾　齊小白入于齊〔俱〕
〔莊公九年〕荊伐鄭〔莊公二十有八年〕
吳伐郯〔成公七年〕
禮記
二者居天下之大端矣故貫四時而不改
柯易葉故君子有禮則外諧而内無
怨故物無不懷仁思神饗德
===
故曰生民之道樂爲大焉
誠信之謂盡盡之謂敬敬盡然後可以事
神明
人苟或言之必聞其聲苟或行之必見其
成
第貳場
論
聖人能使天下順治
詔誥表〔内科一道〕
punctuated:
〔公二年〕突歸于鄭，鄭忽出奔衛〔僖桓公十有〕〔年〕。公伐齊納糾，齊小白入于齊〔俱〕〔莊公九年〕。荊伐鄭〔莊公二十有八年〕。吳伐郯〔成公七年〕。

禮記
二者居天下之大端矣，故貫四時而不改柯易葉。
故君子有禮，則外諧而内無怨。
故物無不懷仁思，神饗德。
故曰：「生民之道，樂爲大焉。」
誠信之謂盡，盡之謂敬，敬盡然後可以事神明。
人苟或言之，必聞其聲；苟或行之，必見其成。

第貳場
論
聖人能使天下順治。
詔誥表〔内科一道〕
translation_en:
…〔second year of Duke Cheng〕.
Tu returned to Zheng; Hu of Zheng fled to Wei. 〔The reign designation is garbled as “Xi Huan”; tenth year [?].〕 The duke attacked Qi to install Jiu; Xiaobai of Qi entered Qi. 〔Both in the ninth year of Duke Zhuang.〕 Jing attacked Zheng. 〔Twenty-eighth year of Duke Zhuang.〕 Wu attacked Tan. 〔Seventh year of Duke Cheng.〕

Book of Rites
These two constitute the great foundations of all under Heaven; thus, throughout the four seasons, they neither change their branches nor replace their leaves.
Thus, when a gentleman observes ritual propriety, he is harmonious in his outward dealings and harbors no resentment within.
Thus, no being fails to cherish benevolent thoughts, and the spirits accept virtue as an offering [?].
Thus it is said: “Of the ways of guiding the people’s lives, music is the greatest.”
Sincerity and trustworthiness are called complete devotion; complete devotion is called reverence. Only with reverence and complete devotion can one serve the spirits.
If someone speaks, his voice must be heard; if someone acts, the result must be seen.

Second Session
Discourse
The sage can bring all under Heaven into obedience and good order.
Imperial edicts, proclamations, and memorials 〔One question from among these categories [?].〕

title: 正德八年河南鄉試錄
text:
擬漢召河南守吳公爲廷尉詔〔文帝元年〕
擬唐以魏徵爲秘書監叅預朝政誥〔貞觀三年〕
擬宋司馬光進稽古錄表〔元祐元年〕
判語〔五條〕
無故不朝叅公座
私剏庵院及私度僧道
公差人員欺陵長官
文書應給驛而不給
虛費功力採取不堪用
===
第叁場
策五道
問帝王之學尚矣堯舜禹授受之間告戒
數語而一心天日於是昭焉湯之建中
武之建極寔得於此湯武之後君不必
皆聖聖不必有位心學不傳而後孔子
傳之大學之書其言格物致知誠意以
正其心以爲脩身齊家治國平天下之
punctuated:
擬漢召河南守吳公爲廷尉詔〔文帝元年〕。
擬唐以魏徵爲秘書監叅預朝政誥〔貞觀三年〕。
擬宋司馬光進稽古錄表〔元祐元年〕。

判語〔五條〕：
無故不朝叅公座。
私剏庵院及私度僧道。
公差人員欺陵長官。
文書應給驛而不給。
虛費功力，採取不堪用。

第叁場
策五道
問：帝王之學尚矣！堯舜禹授受之間，告戒數語，而一心天日於是昭焉。湯之建中，武之建極，寔得於此。湯武之後，君不必皆聖，聖不必有位。心學不傳，而後孔子傳之。《大學》之書，其言格物致知、誠意以正其心，以爲脩身、齊家、治國、平天下之
translation_en:
Compose, as if for the Han court, an edict summoning Wu Gong, Governor of Henan, to become Chamberlain for Law Enforcement. 〔First year of Emperor Wen’s reign.〕
Compose, as if for the Tang court, a proclamation appointing Wei Zheng Director of the Palace Library and a participant in the deliberation of court affairs. 〔Third year of Zhenguan.〕
Compose, as if by Sima Guang of the Song, a memorial presenting his Record of Investigations into Antiquity (Jigu lu). 〔First year of Yuanyou.〕

Legal judgments 〔five items〕:
Failure without cause to attend court or appear at an official assembly [?].
Unauthorized establishment of hermitages and monasteries, and unauthorized ordination of Buddhist monks and Daoist priests.
Personnel on official assignment bullying or insulting superior officials.
Failure to provide postal relay service for documents entitled to it.
Wasteful expenditure of labor in procuring materials unfit for use.

Third Session
Five Policy Questions
Question: The learning of emperors and kings has a venerable history! When Yao, Shun, and Yu transmitted and received rule, their few words of admonition made their shared mind shine forth like the sun in heaven. Tang’s establishment of the mean and Wu’s establishment of the supreme standard truly derived from this. After Tang and Wu, rulers were not necessarily all sages, nor did sages necessarily hold office. The learning of the mind ceased to be transmitted; later, Confucius transmitted it. The Great Learning speaks of investigating things, extending knowledge, and making intentions sincere in order to rectify the mind, taking this as the … for cultivating oneself, regulating the family, governing the state, and bringing peace to all under Heaven …

title: 正德八年河南鄉試錄
text:
本以爲萬世法者至詳悉矣我
太宗文皇帝嗣承
高皇洪業思厥創造明昭有訓是儀是式以爲
作之於前不有以繼之於後無以承藉
悠久遂于
幾務之隙采古嘉言編爲聖學心法一書面
命心傳于
聖子神孫有綱有目有統言者有專言者篇目
之第具載
===
宸翰所序丹青炳煥累數千言而脩德保位序
未貽訓尤拳拳焉綱首君道目先學問
若心法之所指固有在也不知于堯舜
禹之所授受何所發明視孔氏大學之
所條列孰爲詳盡茲欲對揚
燕翼之謀仰贊危微之旨綱之所統言者在
今日以何爲要目之所專言者在今日
以何爲急諸士子潛心聖學有年願敬
陳之有司將轉而
punctuated: 本，以爲萬世法者，至詳悉矣。我太宗文皇帝嗣承高皇洪業，思厥創造，明昭有訓，是儀是式，以爲作之於前，不有以繼之於後，無以承藉悠久。遂于幾務之隙，采古嘉言，編爲《聖學心法》一書，面命心傳于聖子神孫。有綱有目，有統言者，有專言者，篇目之第，具載宸翰所序，丹青炳煥，累數千言。而脩德保位，序未貽訓尤拳拳焉。綱首君道，目先學問，若心法之所指，固有在也。不知于堯舜禹之所授受，何所發明？視孔氏《大學》之所條列，孰爲詳盡？茲欲對揚燕翼之謀，仰贊危微之旨，綱之所統言者，在今日以何爲要？目之所專言者，在今日以何爲急？諸士子潛心聖學有年，願敬陳之，有司將轉而
translation_en: …the foundation, establishing a standard for ten thousand generations, was set forth in the fullest detail. Our Emperor Taizong Wen inherited Emperor Gao’s magnificent enterprise. Reflecting upon its founding, he clearly proclaimed instructions to serve as models and standards. He considered that unless what had been established by his predecessor was carried forward by his successors, there would be no means of sustaining it into the distant future. Accordingly, in intervals between affairs of state, he selected admirable sayings from antiquity and compiled them into a book, Essentials of the Mind in Sagely Learning (Shengxue xinfa), personally instructing his sagely sons and divine grandsons and transmitting its teachings from mind to mind. It has main divisions and subsidiary headings, some treating matters comprehensively and others addressing particular subjects. The sequence of its chapters is fully recorded in the preface written by the imperial hand, whose splendid writing shines brilliantly across several thousand words. Its injunctions concerning the cultivation of virtue and preservation of the throne are especially earnest at the preface’s close [?]. The main divisions begin with the Way of the Ruler, and the subsidiary headings with learning and inquiry: surely the essentials of the mind have a definite purpose here. What do they elucidate concerning the teachings transmitted between Yao, Shun, and Yu? Compared with what is set out under separate headings in Confucius’s Great Learning, which is more exhaustive? Wishing now to extol and carry forward these plans for securing the welfare of descendants, and reverently to illuminate the meaning of the precarious human mind and the subtle mind of the Way, we ask: among the comprehensive teachings of the main divisions, what is most essential today? Among the particular teachings of the subsidiary headings, what is most urgent today? You examination candidates have devoted yourselves to sagely learning for years. We ask that you respectfully set forth your views; the responsible officials will then forward them …

title: 正德八年河南鄉試錄
text:
上聞以裨我
聖天子夙夜敬止之盛德非徒問也
問孔子曰吾未見剛者而孟子則曰我善
養吾浩然之氣夫天地之氣人所同得
養而充之固無難者而乃爲聖人所未
見惟孟子爲善養之其故何也戰國之
士固不必言聖門聰明才辯者不爲不
多乃卒無一剛者乎又况氣之所賦剛
柔異質必至於剛必至於浩然而後爲
===
此氣之充則夫况靜愿慤之質其皆不
足以與此邪或以爲士氣之振靡由於
人主之好惡是故有周之士貴秦之士
賤之說然以嫚罵之時而乃有茹芝之
老驕怠之俗而乃有攀檻之憤凡有志
者則亦何嘗拘於崇獎者之爲而謂氣
節之難邪或以爲天下之事惟有才氣
者能主張之是故有剛則不回柔則不
立之說然龍門風裁卒以成黨錮之禍
punctuated:
上聞，以裨我聖天子夙夜敬止之盛德，非徒問也。
問：孔子曰：「吾未見剛者。」而孟子則曰：「我善養吾浩然之氣。」夫天地之氣，人所同得，養而充之，固無難者，而乃爲聖人所未見，惟孟子爲善養之，其故何也？戰國之士固不必言，聖門聰明才辯者不爲不多，乃卒無一剛者乎？又况氣之所賦，剛柔異質，必至於剛，必至於浩然，而後爲此氣之充，則夫况靜愿慤之質，其皆不足以與此邪？或以爲士氣之振靡，由於人主之好惡，是故有周之士貴、秦之士賤之說。然以嫚罵之時，而乃有茹芝之老；驕怠之俗，而乃有攀檻之憤。凡有志者，則亦何嘗拘於崇獎者之爲，而謂氣節之難邪？或以爲天下之事，惟有才氣者能主張之，是故有剛則不回、柔則不立之說。然龍門風裁，卒以成黨錮之禍，
translation_en:
…report it to the throne, thereby assisting our sagely Son of Heaven in his magnificent virtue of reverent attentiveness morning and night. This is no idle question.
Question: Confucius said, “I have never seen a person of firmness.” Yet Mencius said, “I am skilled at nourishing my vast, flowing qi.” The qi of Heaven and Earth is something all people receive alike. Nourishing it and bringing it to fullness should surely present no difficulty. Yet the Sage had never seen someone possessing such firmness, and only Mencius was skilled at nourishing this qi. Why was this? We need hardly discuss the men of the Warring States period, but among the disciples of the Sage there were certainly many who were intelligent, talented, and eloquent. Was there ultimately not a single person of firmness among them? Moreover, people differ in their endowment of qi, possessing firm or yielding dispositions. If this qi attains fullness only when it becomes firm and vast, are those of quiet [?], sincere, and honest disposition all incapable of sharing in it?
Some hold that whether the spirit of scholars flourishes or declines depends upon the ruler’s likes and dislikes. Hence the saying that scholars were esteemed under the Zhou and despised under the Qin. Yet in an age of insulting abuse there were elders who fed on zhi fungus in retirement; amid customs of arrogance and indolence there was the indignation of one who clung to the palace balustrade in remonstrance. When have men of resolve ever been constrained by the actions of those who confer honor and encouragement? Why, then, speak of integrity as difficult to maintain?
Some hold that only men of talent and spirit can take charge of the affairs of the realm. Hence the saying that the firm do not waver, while the yielding cannot stand their ground. Yet the exemplary bearing and moral judgments associated with Longmen ultimately brought about the disaster of the partisan proscriptions…

title: 正德八年河南鄉試錄
text:
伏闕抗言乃不免編管之禍則又何用
於激烈者之爲而謂氣之可集事邪諸
生皆豪傑有志者也其平居之所以善
養與其所以自任必有得於孔孟之家
法者矣試一言之亦今日學力之驗他
日遠到之地也
問諸子之能見道者在唐莫過於韓子而
諸儒之繼絕學者在宋莫先於周子韓
子當文氣卑弱之餘力起而扶之有謂
===
其識見之大千餘年後斷得分明其取
重如此今其文具在可以舉而論之乎
周子生於道喪千載聖遠言湮之餘有
謂其不由師傳默契道體今其書尚在
亦可以一論之乎然韓子文人也周子
大儒也韓之不可擬乎周人皆知之吾
亦安敢兩重而無拳衡之知哉特其所
以爲儱劣者亦不可無從違之餘而未
有舉其實而並論之焉原道以博愛爲
punctuated:
伏闕抗言，乃不免編管之禍，則又何用於激烈者之爲，而謂氣之可集事邪？諸生皆豪傑有志者也，其平居之所以善養，與其所以自任，必有得於孔孟之家法者矣。試一言之，亦今日學力之驗、他日遠到之地也。

問：諸子之能見道者，在唐莫過於韓子；而諸儒之繼絕學者，在宋莫先於周子。韓子當文氣卑弱之餘，力起而扶之，有謂其識見之大，千餘年後斷得分明，其取重如此。今其文具在，可以舉而論之乎？周子生於道喪千載、聖遠言湮之餘，有謂其不由師傳，默契道體。今其書尚在，亦可以一論之乎？然韓子文人也，周子大儒也，韓之不可擬乎周，人皆知之。吾亦安敢兩重而無拳衡之知哉？特其所以爲儱劣者，亦不可無從違之餘，而未有舉其實而並論之焉。《原道》以博愛爲
translation_en:
…Those who prostrated themselves at the palace gates and spoke out boldly nevertheless suffered banishment under supervision. What use, then, are impassioned actions, and how can one say that such spirit can accomplish affairs? You candidates are all men of outstanding ability and resolve. In the way you cultivate yourselves in daily life and in the responsibilities you take upon yourselves, you must surely have gained something from the teachings handed down by Confucius and Mencius. Set this out briefly: it will both demonstrate the strength of your learning today and provide a foundation for far-reaching achievements in the future.

Question: Among the masters of the Tang who could perceive the Way, none surpassed Master Han; among the Confucian scholars of the Song who continued the interrupted tradition of learning, none preceded Master Zhou. Master Han arose with all his strength to uphold literary vigor after it had fallen into weakness. It has been said that, so great was his discernment, he could make clear judgments more than a thousand years after the events. Such was the esteem he commanded. His writings survive in full today: can you cite and discuss them? Master Zhou was born after the Way had been lost for a thousand years, when the sages were remote and their words obscured. It has been said that, without transmission from a teacher, he silently apprehended the substance of the Way. His books still survive: can you discuss these as well? Yet Master Han was a man of letters, whereas Master Zhou was a great Confucian scholar. Everyone knows that Han cannot be ranked with Zhou. How could I dare esteem both without knowing how to weigh their relative merits [?]? Still, concerning the grounds for judging them muddled and inferior, there must be room for agreement or disagreement [?]; yet no one has brought forward the actual evidence and discussed them together. In On the Way, universal love is taken to be…

title: 正德八年河南鄉試錄
text:
仁謂其遺體而愛曰仁之說不同是病
邪言誠正而不言格致謂其無本而守
貴行利之說恐亦未之及也原性論上
中下三品彼剛柔善惡中之說非其遺
意乎原鬼謂無形聲與氣彼神妙萬物
之說非其遺旨乎夫以其言之大畧相
當如此則固無優劣之可言而謂韓之
不可擬乎周益又甚矣將所以優者乃
在於人而不在於言乎幸爲我一辨之
===
問養士必於學校取士必以貢舉此古今
之通制也我
國家百四十年以來所與共圖治理者亦惟
建學設科以待天下之才耳然學校者
教士之本原貢舉者選士之要法以學
校言之有不毀鄉校者有未遑庠序者
何所見不同歟抑不知不毀者果用之
以養士而未遑者又將養士於何地也
以貢舉言之有別立制舉者有專於文
punctuated:
仁，謂其遺體，而「愛曰仁」之說不同，是病邪？言誠正而不言格致，謂其無本，而「守貴行利」之說恐亦未之及也。《原性》論上中下三品，彼剛柔善惡中之說，非其遺意乎？《原鬼》謂無形聲與氣，彼神妙萬物之說，非其遺旨乎？夫以其言之大畧相當如此，則固無優劣之可言，而謂韓之不可擬乎周，益又甚矣。將所以優者乃在於人而不在於言乎？幸爲我一辨之。
問：養士必於學校，取士必以貢舉，此古今之通制也。我國家百四十年以來，所與共圖治理者，亦惟建學設科以待天下之才耳。然學校者，教士之本原；貢舉者，選士之要法。以學校言之，有不毀鄉校者，有未遑庠序者，何所見不同歟？抑不知不毀者果用之以養士，而未遑者又將養士於何地也？以貢舉言之，有別立制舉者，有專於文
translation_en:
…benevolence. It is said that he neglects its underlying substance and differs from the statement that “love is called benevolence”: is this a fault? He speaks of making the intentions sincere and rectifying the mind, but not of investigating things and extending knowledge, and is therefore said to lack a foundation. Yet the statement about “maintaining what is noble and acting beneficially” [?] probably does not reach these matters either. In On Human Nature, Han Yu discusses the three grades—upper, middle, and lower. Does Zhou Dunyi’s account of firmness, yieldingness, goodness, evil, and the mean not preserve something of Han’s meaning? On Ghosts speaks of the absence of form, sound, and vital energy. Does Zhou’s account of the numinous wondrously acting upon the myriad things not preserve something of Han’s purport? Since their statements broadly correspond in this way, there is surely no basis for speaking of superiority or inferiority; to say that Han cannot be compared with Zhou is therefore all the more excessive. Could the grounds for superiority lie in the person rather than in his words? Please clarify this distinction for me.
Question: Scholars must be nurtured in schools, and selected through the tribute examination system: this has been the common institution from antiquity to the present. For the more than one hundred and forty years of our dynasty, the means of obtaining those with whom to plan and pursue good government have likewise consisted simply in establishing schools and instituting examinations to receive the realm’s talented men. Schools, however, are the foundation for educating scholars, while the tribute examination system is the essential method for selecting them. Regarding schools, some refused to demolish the local schools, while others had no leisure to attend to schools. Why did their views differ? Moreover, did those who refused to demolish them actually use them to nurture scholars? And where were those who had no leisure for schools going to nurture scholars? Regarding the tribute examination system, some separately established special decree examinations, while others concentrated exclusively on literary…

title: 正德八年河南鄉試錄
text:
藝者何立法不一歟抑不知制舉者果
取之於鄉校而文藝者又將取之於何
學也夫士養於學校則行業專而資用
之材博其不由學校而出者亦有周世
之效否邪起於貢舉則趨向正而僥倖
之途塞其不由貢舉而起者亦有不壞
士習者否邪茲欲廣育才之方盡取才
之法以禆當世之用正
今日急務也諸士子幸折衷往昔悉所見以對
===
問時務之急非一今日之所當議若兵與
食亢其不可缺也河南山東流賊之害
始息而江西暨川蜀諸郡亡命之亂未
殄數年間典兵戎者動以單弱上
聞職供餉者每爲匱乏之
請事付
廷議蓋嘗發
禁兵矣調邊兵矣又令調土軍矣嘗給
內帑矣借邊儲矣又開輸粟納銀納馬例矣
punctuated:
藝者，何立法不一歟？抑不知制舉者果取之於鄉校，而文藝者又將取之於何學也？夫士養於學校，則行業專而資用之材博，其不由學校而出者，亦有周世之效否邪？起於貢舉，則趨向正而僥倖之途塞，其不由貢舉而起者，亦有不壞士習者否邪？茲欲廣育才之方，盡取才之法，以禆當世之用，正今日急務也。諸士子幸折衷往昔，悉所見以對。

問：時務之急非一，今日之所當議，若兵與食，亢其不可缺也。河南、山東流賊之害始息，而江西暨川蜀諸郡亡命之亂未殄。數年間，典兵戎者動以單弱上聞，職供餉者每爲匱乏之請。事付廷議，蓋嘗發禁兵矣，調邊兵矣，又令調土軍矣；嘗給內帑矣，借邊儲矣，又開輸粟、納銀、納馬例矣。
translation_en:
…literary accomplishment: why were the systems established not uniform? Moreover, did those conducting special examinations actually recruit from local schools, and from what schools did those selecting by literary accomplishment recruit? When scholars are nurtured in schools, their conduct and studies are focused, and the pool of talent available for service is broad. Have those who emerged outside the schools likewise achieved results comparable to those of the Zhou age? When scholars advance through the examination system, their aspirations are properly directed and avenues of advancement through mere good fortune are closed. Have there likewise been cases in which advancement outside that system did not corrupt the ethos of scholars? To broaden the means of nurturing talent and employ fully the methods of selecting it, so as to meet the needs of the present age, is precisely the urgent task of today. You candidates should weigh the precedents of the past and set out your views fully in reply.

Question: There is more than one urgent matter of current affairs. Among those that ought to be discussed today, troops and provisions are both indispensable [?]. The depredations of roving bandits in Henan and Shandong have only just subsided, while the uprisings of outlaws in Jiangxi and the various prefectures of Sichuan have not yet been quelled. In recent years, those commanding troops have repeatedly reported to the throne that their forces are few and weak, while those responsible for military supplies have continually petitioned on account of shortages. These matters have been referred for deliberation at court. Imperial guard troops have been dispatched, frontier troops redeployed, and orders issued to mobilize native troops. Funds have been supplied from the imperial treasury, frontier reserves borrowed, and provisions introduced permitting contributions of grain, silver, and horses…

title: 正德八年河南鄉試錄
text:
憂貽
宵旰事出權宜老成于此甚非其得已也
國家承平日久休養生息不爲不至而所在
地方一遇警急輒弗自支吾不知府衛
平素之所訓練而赳赳稱武者置於何
地田賦往昔之所征歛而陳陳相因者
積於何所居重馭輕國之大勢顧此失
彼人之通患而不虞之變代不能無苟
事往而弗圖將事至而無措
===
禁兵其可常發邊兵其可常調而土軍之獷
悍其可常用乎
內帑其可常給邊儲其可常借而輸納之例
其可常開乎夫安不忘危慮當及遠一
之已甚再必難繼茲欲增壯丁以助戎
行之不足而或者病其妨農欲清屯地
以補稅額之舊逋而或者議其厲衆善
後之計當何所從識時務者在俊傑諸
士子以俊傑而自待者矧足食足兵孔
punctuated: 憂貽宵旰，事出權宜，老成于此甚非其得已也。國家承平日久，休養生息不爲不至，而所在地方一遇警急，輒弗自支。吾不知府衛平素之所訓練而赳赳稱武者，置於何地？田賦往昔之所征歛而陳陳相因者，積於何所？居重馭輕，國之大勢；顧此失彼，人之通患。而不虞之變，代不能無。苟事往而弗圖，將事至而無措。禁兵其可常發，邊兵其可常調，而土軍之獷悍，其可常用乎？內帑其可常給，邊儲其可常借，而輸納之例，其可常開乎？夫安不忘危，慮當及遠。一之已甚，再必難繼。茲欲增壯丁，以助戎行之不足，而或者病其妨農；欲清屯地，以補稅額之舊逋，而或者議其厲衆。善後之計，當何所從？識時務者在俊傑。諸士子以俊傑而自待者，矧足食足兵，孔
translation_en:
…These concerns have burdened His Majesty, who attends to affairs from before dawn until late at night. The measures adopted have been expedients; even seasoned statesmen have had little choice in the matter.

The realm has enjoyed peace for many years, and its efforts to foster recovery and sustain the people cannot be called inadequate. Yet whenever an emergency arises, the locality concerned cannot support itself. I do not know where the men regularly trained by the prefectures and guards, acclaimed as valiant warriors, have been stationed. Where have the grain revenues collected in former years, supposedly accumulating harvest upon harvest, been stored? Maintaining a strong center to control the outlying regions is the broad configuration of state power; attending to one concern while neglecting another is a common human failing. Yet no age can be free of unforeseen upheavals. If, once an incident has passed, no plans are made, then when the next arrives there will be no means of dealing with it.

Can the imperial guard troops be sent out continually? Can frontier troops continually be transferred? And can the fierce and unruly native troops be employed continually? Can the imperial treasury continually supply funds? Can frontier reserves continually be borrowed? And can provisions for contributions of grain, silver, and horses continually be opened? In security, one must not forget danger; deliberation must extend into the distant future. Doing this once is already excessive; doing it again will surely be difficult to sustain.

Now we wish to increase the number of able-bodied men to make up the army’s shortfall, but some object that this would hinder farming. We wish to survey and regularize military agricultural colony lands to make good longstanding arrears in the tax quota, but some argue that this would oppress the people. What course should we follow in planning for the aftermath? It is outstanding men who understand the needs of the times. You candidates regard yourselves as such outstanding men. Moreover, concerning sufficient food and sufficient troops, Kong…

translation_en:
First Session
Four Books

“Wealth and high rank are what people desire. If they cannot be obtained by the proper way, one does not remain in them. Poverty and low status are what people dislike. If they are incurred otherwise than by the proper way, one does not abandon them.”

Li Lian

Associate Examiner Qin, Assistant Instructor, comments: “Other essays mostly describe wealth and high rank, poverty and low status, yet offer not a single word of exposition on ‘not by the proper way.’ This essay knows what deserves greater or lesser emphasis and weighs its treatment carefully. Its writing is also mature and vigorous. It should be selected and placed in a high grade.”

Associate Examiner Sang, Instructor, comments: “Classical and elegant, gentle and generous in tone; without wasting words, it fully conveys the principles. An excellent composition.”

Examiner Wang, Instructor, comments: “Its close appreciation of the need to scrutinize wealth and high rank and to remain content in poverty and low status shows very clear discernment.”

Examiner Lu, Professor, comments: “Its discussion of practicing benevolence is direct and pertinent; the author excels in more than the study of the Classics alone.”

In discussing the gentleman’s practice of benevolence, the Sage locates it in scrutinizing wealth and high rank and remaining content in poverty and low status. For it is precisely in choosing whether to accept or reject wealth and high rank, poverty and low status, that one exerts oneself in benevolence. If the gentleman can scrutinize these in accordance with righteousness and rest content in what Heaven has allotted, the distinction between what to accept and what to reject becomes clear. Surely this is how benevolence is practiced!

The Sage’s meaning was, as it were: “Benevolence embodies all things and leaves nothing out; wherever people find themselves, they must never neglect it. Wealth and high rank are both favorable circumstances. Even those with firm aspirations cannot be free of private longings for them. Who does not desire them? Yet righteousness has its place here: what matters is scrutinizing …

title: 正德八年河南鄉試錄
text:
之而已苟或授受不合於禮進退不由其道是
富貴所不當得矣不當得而得之君子則曰富
貴可欲而吾心之仁尤可欲於此而處之寧不
害吾仁乎于是繫馬千駟視之如浮雲也祿以
萬鍾棄之如敝蹝也其審富貴而不處也如此
若貧與賤皆逆境雖有守者不能無憂戚之態
人孰不惡之然有命存焉在安之而已苟或事
勢出於不虞變故起於無妄是貧賤所不當得
矣不當得而得之君子則曰貧賤可惡而吾之
===
不仁尤可惡於此而去之寧不違吾仁乎于是
飯糗茹草若將終身也困窮拂鬱若固有之也
其安貧賤而不去也如此夫審於所欲則非決
性命之情以饕富貴安於所惡則非徇人欲之
私以厭貧賤取舍之分明而本心之仁全矣此
其所以能成君子之名而獨有以異於衆人也
歟大抵富貴貧賤好惡異情取舍異向自非樂
天知命君子孰肯舍其所好而取其所惡哉求
之於古吾於孔孟見之矣觀其不主癰子與不
punctuated: 之而已。苟或授受不合於禮，進退不由其道，是富貴所不當得矣。不當得而得之，君子則曰：「富貴可欲，而吾心之仁尤可欲。於此而處之，寧不害吾仁乎？」于是，繫馬千駟，視之如浮雲也；祿以萬鍾，棄之如敝蹝也。其審富貴而不處也如此。若貧與賤，皆逆境，雖有守者，不能無憂戚之態，人孰不惡之？然有命存焉，在安之而已。苟或事勢出於不虞，變故起於無妄，是貧賤所不當得矣。不當得而得之，君子則曰：「貧賤可惡，而吾之不仁尤可惡。於此而去之，寧不違吾仁乎？」于是，飯糗茹草，若將終身也；困窮拂鬱，若固有之也。其安貧賤而不去也如此。夫審於所欲，則非決性命之情以饕富貴；安於所惡，則非徇人欲之私以厭貧賤。取舍之分明，而本心之仁全矣。此其所以能成君子之名，而獨有以異於衆人也歟！大抵富貴貧賤，好惡異情，取舍異向。自非樂天知命君子，孰肯舍其所好而取其所惡哉？求之於古，吾於孔孟見之矣。觀其不主癰子與不
translation_en:
…one need only scrutinize them. If giving and receiving do not accord with ritual propriety, and advancement and withdrawal do not follow the proper Way, then such wealth and rank ought not to be obtained. When they come to him despite this, the gentleman says: “Wealth and rank are desirable, but the humaneness in my heart is still more desirable. If I remain in such a position, will I not harm my humaneness?” Thus he regards a thousand teams of four horses tethered in his stables as floating clouds, and discards a stipend of ten thousand measures of grain like worn-out sandals. Such is his scrutiny of wealth and rank and his refusal to remain in them.

Poverty and low status, on the other hand, are both adverse circumstances. Even those steadfast in their principles cannot be entirely free of a sorrowful demeanor: who does not dislike them? Yet destiny is at work here; one need only rest content with it. If circumstances arise unexpectedly and misfortunes occur through no fault of one’s own, then such poverty and low status ought not to have befallen one. When they come to him despite this, the gentleman says: “Poverty and low status are hateful, but my own lack of humaneness would be still more hateful. If I escape them under these circumstances, will I not act against my humaneness?” Thus he eats parched grain and wild plants as though he would do so all his life, and endures hardship and frustration as though they were his natural lot. Such is his contentment with poverty and low status and his refusal to escape them.

By scrutinizing what he desires, he avoids injuring the true qualities of his nature and allotted life in his greed for wealth and rank; by resting content with what he dislikes, he avoids indulging selfish human desires in his aversion to poverty and low status. The distinction between what to accept and what to reject becomes clear, and the humaneness of his original heart remains whole. Is this not how he earns the name of gentleman and distinguishes himself from ordinary people? In general, wealth and rank, poverty and low status evoke different feelings of liking and dislike, and different inclinations to accept or reject. Unless he is a gentleman who delights in Heaven and understands destiny, who would willingly relinquish what he likes and accept what he dislikes? title: 正德八年河南鄉試錄
text:
受齊卿之祿君子固窮與不遇魯侯之說同一
審富貴而安貧賤耳他如子貢猶不免於貨殖
而冉求亦爲之聚斂其餘可知也已噫仁與不
仁之分公私義利之間而已矣學者不可不辨
苟不固聰明聖知達天德者其孰能知之
吳瀚

title: 正德八年河南鄉試錄
text:
知之資而天之所賦於已者備其全而不偏達
仁義禮智之德而性之所出於天者究其極而
不昧吾見質非生知則無以爲凝聚培植之基
德非至聖則無以爲融會貫通之地體之未至
見之未真吘性命於兩途而天之與人判然其
間隔矣行矣不著習矣不察視道器爲二物而
人之於天邈然其懸絶矣想像於形迹之粗所
謂經綸大經而與仁無二之妙探之而愈遠也
測之而愈深也孰能超詣頓悟而真知其蘊奥
===
邪議擬於口耳之間所謂立本知化而天淵合
一之妙仰之而彌高也鑽之而彌堅也孰能神
會黙契而洞見其精微邪夫至誠之道非至聖
不能知至聖之德非至誠不能爲則亦非二物
矣子思子發明聖人天道之極致尚何以加于
此哉抑又論之天下之言二有有德之言有造
道之言中庸所謂大德敦化小德川流發明聖
人天道至此而無以加矣求其可以當之者惟
吾夫子焉耳故非夫子之聖不足以知之亦不
punctuated:
知之資，而天之所賦於已者備其全而不偏，達仁義禮智之德，而性之所出於天者究其極而不昧。吾見質非生知，則無以爲凝聚培植之基；德非至聖，則無以爲融會貫通之地。體之未至，見之未真，吘性命於兩途，而天之與人判然其間隔矣；行矣不著，習矣不察，視道器爲二物，而人之於天邈然其懸絶矣。想像於形迹之粗，所謂經綸大經而與仁無二之妙，探之而愈遠也，測之而愈深也，孰能超詣頓悟而真知其蘊奥邪？議擬於口耳之間，所謂立本知化而天淵合一之妙，仰之而彌高也，鑽之而彌堅也，孰能神會黙契而洞見其精微邪？夫至誠之道，非至聖不能知；至聖之德，非至誠不能爲，則亦非二物矣。子思子發明聖人天道之極致，尚何以加于此哉？

抑又論之，天下之言二：有有德之言，有造道之言。《中庸》所謂大德敦化，小德川流，發明聖人天道，至此而無以加矣。求其可以當之者，惟吾夫子焉耳。故非夫子之聖，不足以知之，亦不
translation_en:
…the endowment of sagacity, possessing in full and without partiality what Heaven has bestowed upon oneself, and fully realizing the virtues of benevolence, righteousness, ritual propriety, and wisdom, comprehending to their utmost, without obscurity, the nature that comes from Heaven. I see that unless one is endowed with knowledge from birth, one lacks the foundation for gathering, nurturing, and cultivating these qualities; unless one’s virtue is that of the utmost sage, one lacks the ground for integrating them into a comprehensive understanding. If one’s embodiment of them is incomplete and one’s perception of them untrue, one separates human nature and Heaven’s mandate into two paths [?], leaving Heaven and humanity distinctly divided. Acting without understanding and practicing without discernment, one regards the Way and concrete things as two separate entities, leaving humanity remote from Heaven, an immeasurable distance apart. If one merely imagines things through their coarse outward traces, then the subtlety of ordering the great enduring relationships while being wholly one with benevolence recedes ever farther as one explores it and grows ever deeper as one fathoms it. Who could attain a transcendent insight and sudden awakening, truly knowing its hidden profundities? If one merely discusses and conjectures within the bounds of what passes from mouth to ear, then the subtlety of establishing the foundation and knowing transformation, wherein Heaven and the abyss unite as one, grows ever higher as one looks up to it and ever harder as one bores into it. Who could apprehend it spiritually and accord with it silently, penetrating its finest subtleties? The Way of utmost sincerity can be known only by the utmost sage; the virtue of the utmost sage can be realized only through utmost sincerity. Thus these, too, are not two separate things. Master Zisi has elucidated the highest attainment of the sage and the Way of Heaven: what more could possibly be added?

Let us consider this further. There are two kinds of utterance in the world: the utterances of those who possess virtue, and those of people who have attained the Way. What the Doctrine of the Mean calls “great virtue abundantly effecting transformation” and “lesser virtues flowing like rivers” elucidates the sage and the Way of Heaven to a point beyond which nothing can be added. If we seek someone who answers to this description, there is only our Master, Confucius. Thus, without the sageliness of Confucius, one could not know it, nor could one…

title: 正德八年河南鄉試錄
text:
能以體之而子思子又衍知之之意邪夫中庸
之知乃至聖之知非聞見之知也子思之言其
亦造道之言也歟
聖人治天下使有菽粟如水火菽粟如水
火而民焉有不仁者乎
李茂元
同考試官教諭黃　批〔說使字上說治天下之意〕
是且不悖於慳吝不仁之說此真有學識者
同考試官教諭鄒　批〔場中作此題者多以教養立說〕
殊失本旨是篇詞簡意盡發義而出之
===
考試官學正王　批〔脫去浮華而歸於雅淡若此篇者〕
亦鮮矣
考試官教授陸　批〔文字着實見識超邁非苟作者〕
聖人之治世惟有以裕乎民固有以化乎民蓋
民富則善心生善心生則於治亦易矣君天下
者曷亦自其先者而圖之乎昔孟子之意蓋謂
民可使之富也亦可使之仁也聖人有見於此
故其治天下也必使易田疇薄稅斂凡可以厚
punctuated:
能以體之，而子思子又衍知之之意邪？夫中庸之知，乃至聖之知，非聞見之知也。子思之言，其亦造道之言也歟？

聖人治天下，使有菽粟如水火。菽粟如水火，而民焉有不仁者乎？
李茂元

同考試官教諭黃　批〔說使字上說治天下之意〕是，且不悖於慳吝不仁之說，此真有學識者。

同考試官教諭鄒　批〔場中作此題者多以教養立說〕殊失本旨。是篇詞簡意盡，發義而出之。

考試官學正王　批〔脫去浮華而歸於雅淡若此篇者〕亦鮮矣。

translation_en:
…embody it; and does Master Zisi further elaborate the meaning of knowing it? The knowledge spoken of in the Doctrine of the Mean is the knowledge of the supreme sage, not knowledge acquired through hearing and seeing. Are Zisi’s words, then, also words expressing attainment of the Way?

“When a sage governs the world, he ensures that beans and grain are as plentiful as water and fire. When beans and grain are as plentiful as water and fire, how could there be anyone among the people who is not benevolent?”
By Li Maoyuan.

Associate Examiner Huang, Instructor, comments: 〔The explanation of the word ‘ensures,’ through which the meaning of governing the world is explained,〕 is correct. Moreover, it does not conflict with the account of stinginess as a failure of benevolence. This is truly someone with learning and discernment.

Associate Examiner Zou, Instructor, comments: 〔Most candidates in the examination who wrote on this topic based their arguments on educating and nourishing the people,〕 thoroughly missing its original purport. This essay is concise in wording yet complete in meaning, bringing out and articulating the underlying significance.

Examiner Wang, School Instructor, comments: 〔Essays like this one, which cast off florid ornament and return to refined simplicity,〕 are indeed rare.

Examiner Lu, Professor, comments: 〔The writing is substantial, the understanding exceptional; this is no careless composition.〕

When a sage governs the age, precisely by providing abundantly for the people, he also possesses the means to transform them. For when the people are prosperous, good impulses arise; when good impulses arise, governing them becomes easy. Why should one who rules the world not plan his efforts by beginning with what comes first? Mencius’s meaning in former times was that the people can be made prosperous and can also be made benevolent. The sage understands this. title: 正德八年河南鄉試錄
text:
民生者無不用也食以時用以禮凡可以教民
儉者無不至也藏富于民而菽粟之入隨用隨
有譬諸水火至足求者無弗與矣散財于下而
菽粟之積隨取隨足譬諸水火之多與者無或
慽矣夫如是吾知財用饒洽之餘既有以遂其
俯仰之願飽煖安逸之後又得以存其固有之
天禮義之心生而淳龎之風著會極歸極沛然
德化之大同也焉有偷薄而爲不仁者乎廉耻
之俗振而雍熈之化成遵道遵路藹然德教之
===
洋溢也曾有放僻而爲不仁者乎吁不患民心
之未仁而患民用之不足民用既足則民心自
仁而治道畢矣聖人之治天下孰有急於此者
邪雖然禮義生於富足固也後世乃有頭會箕
歛而爲富國之計者殆亦弗思之甚歟夫君民
一體君苟富矣而民負焉則劫奪之禍起而所
謂仁心者喪矣雖有粟吾得而食諸此孟子所
以拳拳欲人君先足乎民也有若告哀公亦曰
百姓足君孰與不足合而觀之益信
punctuated:
民生者，無不用也；食以時，用以禮，凡可以教民儉者，無不至也。藏富于民，而菽粟之入隨用隨有，譬諸水火至足，求者無弗與矣；散財于下，而菽粟之積隨取隨足，譬諸水火之多，與者無或慽矣。
夫如是，吾知財用饒洽之餘，既有以遂其俯仰之願；飽煖安逸之後，又得以存其固有之天。禮義之心生，而淳龎之風著，會極歸極，沛然德化之大同也，焉有偷薄而爲不仁者乎？廉耻之俗振，而雍熈之化成，遵道遵路，藹然德教之洋溢也，曾有放僻而爲不仁者乎？
吁！不患民心之未仁，而患民用之不足。民用既足，則民心自仁，而治道畢矣。聖人之治天下，孰有急於此者邪？雖然，禮義生於富足，固也；後世乃有頭會箕歛而爲富國之計者，殆亦弗思之甚歟！夫君民一體，君苟富矣，而民負焉，則劫奪之禍起，而所謂仁心者喪矣。雖有粟，吾得而食諸？此孟子所以拳拳欲人君先足乎民也。有若告哀公亦曰：「百姓足，君孰與不足？」合而觀之，益信。
translation_en:
…whatever might enrich the people's livelihood, he employs it all. They eat at the proper times and spend in accordance with ritual propriety; he leaves nothing undone that might teach the people frugality. Wealth is stored among the people, and supplies of beans and grain are available whenever needed. It is like water and fire being so abundant that no one who asks is refused. Wealth is distributed among those below, and stores of beans and grain remain sufficient however much is taken. It is like the abundance of water and fire: those who give have no cause for distress.
Under such conditions, I know that ample resources enable the people to fulfill their wish to support their parents above and their dependents below. Once well fed, warmly clothed, secure, and at ease, they can also preserve their inherent Heaven-endowed nature. A sense of ritual propriety and righteousness arises, and a generous, honest way of life becomes manifest. Gathering at and returning to the supreme standard, they share fully in the great concord brought about by moral transformation. How could anyone become mean and ungenerous and act without benevolence? Habits of integrity and shame flourish, and harmonious, splendid governance is achieved. Following the Way and its paths, they are steeped in the abundant influence of moral instruction. Could anyone indulge in perversity and act without benevolence?
Ah! The concern is not that the people's hearts have yet to become benevolent, but that their material needs are unmet. Once those needs are satisfied, their hearts naturally become benevolent, and the work of government is complete. In the sage's government of the world, what could be more urgent than this? Nevertheless, although ritual propriety and righteousness indeed arise from abundance, in later ages there have been those who devise plans to enrich the state by levying taxes on every head and gathering revenues as though with a winnowing basket. Surely this is an extreme failure of reflection! Ruler and people form one body. If the ruler becomes wealthy while the people bear the burden, the calamity of plunder and robbery will arise, and what is called the benevolent heart will be lost. Even if I possess grain, will I be able to eat it? This is why Mengzi so earnestly wished rulers first to provide adequately for their people. You Ruo also told Duke Ai: “If the common people have enough, how could their ruler alone lack enough?” Considered together, these sayings make the principle still more convincing.

title: 正德八年河南鄉試錄
text:
易
王假有家交相愛也
吴瀚

〔複今人厭觀此作不然是宜録出〕

考試官教授陸　批〔易義合作〕
===
象傳舉王者納后之辭而著其兩相與之情也
夫家人相與貴乎内外有同德也九五有家而
得其人焉其情之相愛也可知昔夫子小象釋
家人九五爻義謂夫九五剛健中正男之正位
乎外者也下應六二之柔順中正女之正位乎
内者也以是相求則是正者及嬪婉之辰而天
作之合中饋獲歸於所主后妃有窈窕之淑而
文定厥祥君子獲諧其所配陰禮聿脩無非無
儀閨壼于焉而肅穆矣毋訓不忘必敬必戒邦
punctuated:
易

王假有家，交相愛也。

吴瀚

同考試官教諭楊批〔題本不難作，而場中士子於假家處竟不能化本義一語，有併勿恤吉而入講者；至交相愛處，不免語意滯〕〔複，今人厭觀。此作不然，是宜録出。〕
