He consulted the prescribed regulations and procedures; every measure appropriate for encouraging the undertaking was provided for more fully than before. Xu Wan, the Investigating Censor charged with inspecting military registers, was also due to arrive under imperial orders.

The Right Administration Vice Commissioners Hu Yue, Zang Feng, and Liu Xian; the Surveillance Vice Commissioners Li Xi and Wen Hao; the Left Administration Assistant Commissioner Dong Rui; the Right Administration Assistant Commissioner Shi Zhao; and the Surveillance Assistant Commissioners Chen He, Wang Xuan, He Zheng, Wang Na, Hui Xiang [?], Feng Xiang, Liu Wen [?], Chong Ze [?], Liu Ninghe [?], Zeng Da [?], and Xian Xiang [?] together assisted in conducting the examination. They strove to obtain worthy men for the court, befitting the flourishing circumstances of the present day. Their intent …

title: 正德八年河南鄉試錄
text:
心均也抑〔賢〕於是重有感焉
辛未壬申之歲盜發畿甸軼
河南北戎馬生郊氛厲徧野
使賓賢之期弗適平盜之後
八郡士皇皇馬行畏豺狼居
苦荆棘安得從容暇豫旅集
藝塲抽閟騁妍以決進取而
===
爲之鎮巡者方身任安危勞
精役知帷幄間藩臬重臣亦
皆躍馬總干奔命行陣諸有
司憂切扞防安得曠月相從
以畢意於鉛槧然則今日衣
冠慶會風恬日熙寔
上天眷命
punctuated: 心均也。抑〔賢〕於是重有感焉。辛未、壬申之歲，盜發畿甸，軼河南北，戎馬生郊，氛厲徧野。使賓賢之期弗適平盜之後，八郡士皇皇馬，行畏豺狼，居苦荆棘，安得從容暇豫，旅集藝塲，抽閟騁妍，以決進取？而爲之鎮巡者，方身任安危，勞精役知帷幄間；藩臬重臣亦皆躍馬總干，奔命行陣；諸有司憂切扞防，安得曠月相從，以畢意於鉛槧？然則今日衣冠慶會，風恬日熙，寔上天眷命
translation_en:
…their dedication was the same. Yet I, Xian 〔賢〕, have further reflections on this. In the xinwei and renshen years (1511 and 1512), bandits arose in the metropolitan region and swept through the lands south and north of the Yellow River. Warhorses appeared in the outskirts, and a baleful atmosphere spread throughout the countryside. Had the occasion for receiving worthy scholars as honored guests not fallen after the suppression of the bandits, the scholars of the eight prefectures would have been in anxious turmoil [?], fearing jackals and wolves when traveling and suffering among thorns and brambles at home. How could they have gathered at leisure in the examination grounds, brought forth their hidden talents and displayed their literary brilliance, to determine their advancement?

Meanwhile, the regional commanders and grand coordinators responsible for the region were personally bearing responsibility for its security, exhausting their energies and intellects in military councils. The senior officials of the Provincial Administration and Surveillance Commissions likewise mounted horses and took up shields, rushing to fulfill their duties in the battle ranks. The various local authorities were deeply preoccupied with defense. How could they have spent an entire month together, devoting their full attention to brush and tablet?

Thus, today's joyous gathering of men in caps and robes, with gentle winds and radiant sunshine, is truly due to Heaven's bestowal of favor and its mandate upon …

title: 正德八年河南鄉試錄
text:
皇上而特祐才賢使輔
至治于方來也夫豈偶哉今在選
之士極蔼蔼濟濟之盛行將
上眷官對
大廷布列有位尚相與勉之所
以保豐持泰億萬斯年以酬
聖顧荅
天眷者是科當必有人焉踵洛出
而肩嶽降吾有望於是科得
人之稱盛矣
直隷順德府儒學教授陸賢
謹序
punctuated:
皇上，而特祐才賢，使輔至治于方來也，夫豈偶哉？今在選之士，極蔼蔼濟濟之盛，行將上眷官對大廷，布列有位，尚相與勉之。所以保豐持泰，億萬斯年，以酬聖顧、荅天眷者，是科當必有人焉。踵洛出而肩嶽降，吾有望於是科得人之稱盛矣。
直隷順德府儒學教授陸賢謹序。
translation_en:
…His Majesty, and especially blesses the talented and worthy, so that they may assist in bringing about consummate government in the years to come. How could this be mere chance? Those now selected form an exceptionally abundant and distinguished company. Soon they will receive imperial favor and answer before the imperial court [?], taking their places in official posts. May they encourage one another in their efforts! Among this examination’s successful candidates there must surely be men who will preserve prosperity and sustain peace for countless years, thereby repaying the sovereign’s regard and answering Heaven’s favor. Following in the footsteps of those who emerged from the Luo River and standing alongside those sent down by the sacred mountains, they give me hope that this examination will win great acclaim for obtaining worthy men.
Preface respectfully composed by Lu Xian, Instructor in the Confucian School of Shunde Prefecture, in the directly administered metropolitan region.

title: 正德八年河南鄉試錄
text:
第壹塲
四書
富與貴是人之所欲也不以其道得之不
處也貧與賤是人之所惡也不以其
道得之不去也
苟不固聰明聖知達天德者其孰能知之
聖人治天下使有菽粟如水火菽粟如水
火而民焉有不仁者乎
易
初六有孚比之无咎有孚盈缶終來有他
===
吉
王假有家交相愛也
謙也者致恭以存其位者也
往者屈也來者信也屈信相感而利生焉
書
肆類于上帝禋于六宗望于山川徧于羣
神
欽厥止率乃祖攸行
punctuated:
第壹塲

四書

富與貴，是人之所欲也；不以其道得之，不處也。貧與賤，是人之所惡也；不以其道得之，不去也。

苟不固聰明聖知達天德者，其孰能知之？

聖人治天下，使有菽粟如水火。菽粟如水火，而民焉有不仁者乎？

易

初六：有孚，比之，无咎。有孚盈缶，終來有他吉。

王假有家，交相愛也。

謙也者，致恭以存其位者也。

往者屈也，來者信也；屈信相感，而利生焉。

書

肆類于上帝，禋于六宗，望于山川，徧于羣神。

欽厥止，率乃祖攸行，
translation_en:
First Session

Four Books

Wealth and high station are what people desire. If they cannot be obtained in accordance with the Way, one does not accept them. Poverty and low station are what people dislike. If they cannot be escaped in accordance with the Way, one does not leave them.

Unless one is truly perceptive, sagely, and wise, comprehending Heaven’s virtue, who could understand this?

When a sage governs all under Heaven, he ensures that beans and grain are as plentiful as water and fire. If beans and grain are as plentiful as water and fire, how could any of the people fail to be benevolent?

Book of Changes

Six in the first place: With sincerity, join with others, and there will be no blame. With sincerity filling an earthen vessel, further good fortune will come in the end.

“The king comes to have a family”: its members love one another.

Modesty means showing the utmost respect in order to preserve one’s position.

What goes contracts; what comes extends. Contraction and extension act upon one another, and benefit arises from them.

Book of Documents

Thereupon he performed the lei sacrifice to the Lord on High, offered pure sacrifices to the Six Honored Powers, sacrificed from afar to the mountains and rivers, and extended his sacrifices to all the spirits.

Be reverent in your conduct, and follow the practices of your forebears …

title: 正德八年河南鄉試錄
text:
是訓是行以近天子之光
爾身克正罔敢弗正民心罔中惟爾之中
詩
二之日其同載纘武功言私其豵獻豜于
公
衆維魚矣實維豐年旐維旟矣室家溱溱
鳳凰鳴矣于彼高岡梧桐生矣于彼朝陽
菶菶萋萋雝雝喈喈君子之車既庶
且多君子之馬既閑且馳
===
休矣皇考以保明其身
春秋
諸侯遂救許〔僖公六年〕諸侯遂圍許〔僖公〕
〔二十有八年〕
楚子入陳〔宣公十有一年〕楚子圍鄭 晉
荀林父帥師及楚子戰于邲晉師敗
績〔俱宣公十有二年〕晉欒書帥師救
鄭〔成公六年〕遂滅偪陽〔襄公十年〕
齊侯使國佐如師 及國佐盟于袁婁〔成〕
punctuated:
是訓是行，以近天子之光。爾身克正，罔敢弗正；民心罔中，惟爾之中。

詩
二之日其同，載纘武功。言私其豵，獻豜于公。衆維魚矣，實維豐年；旐維旟矣，室家溱溱。鳳凰鳴矣，于彼高岡；梧桐生矣，于彼朝陽。菶菶萋萋，雝雝喈喈。君子之車，既庶且多；君子之馬，既閑且馳。休矣皇考，以保明其身。

春秋
諸侯遂救許〔僖公六年〕。諸侯遂圍許〔僖公〕〔二十有八年〕。
楚子入陳〔宣公十有一年〕。楚子圍鄭。晉荀林父帥師及楚子戰于邲，晉師敗績〔俱宣公十有二年〕。晉欒書帥師救鄭〔成公六年〕。遂滅偪陽〔襄公十年〕。
齊侯使國佐如師。及國佐盟于袁婁〔成〕
translation_en:
Follow these teachings and put them into practice, thereby drawing near to the radiance of the Son of Heaven. If you yourself can be upright, none will dare to be otherwise. If the people’s hearts lack the mean, they will take your adherence to the mean as their standard.

Book of Odes
In the days of the second month, they assemble and continue their martial training. They keep the young boars for themselves and present the full-grown boars to their lord.
The multitude are fish: truly, this signifies an abundant year. Tortoise-and-serpent banners and falcon banners fly; households are numerous and flourishing.
The phoenixes call upon that high ridge; the paulownias grow upon its sunward slope. Luxuriant and abundant is their growth; harmonious and melodious are the birds’ calls. The lord’s chariots are numerous indeed; the lord’s horses are well trained and swift.
Glorious was the august deceased father, who preserved and made illustrious his person.

Spring and Autumn Annals
The lords thereupon went to the relief of Xu. 〔Sixth year of Duke Xi.〕 The lords thereupon besieged Xu. 〔Duke Xi,〕〔twenty-eighth year.〕
The Viscount of Chu entered Chen. 〔Eleventh year of Duke Xuan.〕 The Viscount of Chu besieged Zheng. Xun Linfu of Jin led an army into battle against the Viscount of Chu at Bi; the Jin army suffered a crushing defeat. 〔Both in the twelfth year of Duke Xuan.〕 Luan Shu of Jin led an army to relieve Zheng. 〔Sixth year of Duke Cheng.〕 They thereupon destroyed Biyang. 〔Tenth year of Duke Xiang.〕
The Marquis of Qi sent Guo Zuo to the army. A covenant was concluded with Guo Zuo at Yuanlou. 〔Duke Cheng …〕

title: 正德八年河南鄉試錄
text:
〔公二年〕
突歸于鄭〔鄭忽出奔衛桓公十有一年〕
〔年〕公伐齊納糾　齊小白入于齊〔俱莊公九年〕
荆伐鄭〔莊公二十有八年〕
吳伐郯〔成公七年〕
禮記
二者居天下之大端矣故貫四時而不改
柯易葉故君子有禮則外諧而內無
怨故物無不懷仁鬼神饗德
===
故曰生民之道樂爲大焉
誠信之謂盡盡之謂敬敬盡然後可以事
神明
人苟或言之必聞其聲苟或行之必見其
成
第貳場
論
聖人能使天下順治
詔誥表內科一道
punctuated:
〔公二年〕
突歸于鄭〔鄭忽出奔衛桓公十有一年〕。〔年〕公伐齊納糾，齊小白入于齊〔俱莊公九年〕。荆伐鄭〔莊公二十有八年〕。吳伐郯〔成公七年〕。
禮記
二者居天下之大端矣。故貫四時而不改柯易葉。故君子有禮則外諧而內無怨。故物無不懷仁，鬼神饗德。
故曰：「生民之道，樂爲大焉。」
誠信之謂盡，盡之謂敬，敬盡然後可以事神明。
人苟或言之，必聞其聲；苟或行之，必見其成。
第貳場
論
聖人能使天下順治。
詔誥表內科一道。
translation_en:
…〔Second year of Duke Cheng.〕
Tu returned to Zheng. 〔Hu of Zheng fled to Wei; eleventh year of Duke Huan.〕 〔Year [?].〕 The duke attacked Qi to install Jiu; Xiaobai of Qi entered Qi. 〔Both in the ninth year of Duke Zhuang.〕 Jing attacked Zheng. 〔Twenty-eighth year of Duke Zhuang.〕 Wu attacked Tan. 〔Seventh year of Duke Cheng.〕
Record of Rites (Liji)
These two constitute the great essentials of all under Heaven. Thus, through all four seasons, it neither changes its branches nor replaces its leaves. Thus, when the gentleman possesses ritual propriety, he is harmonious outwardly and harbors no resentment inwardly. Thus, all beings cherish his benevolence, and ghosts and spirits savor his virtue.
Thus it is said: “Of the ways of governing the people, music is the greatest.”
Sincerity and trustworthiness are called complete devotion; complete devotion is called reverence. Only with reverence and complete devotion can one serve the spirits.
If anyone speaks, his voice will surely be heard; if anyone acts, the results will surely be seen.
Second Session
Discourse
The sage can bring all under Heaven into harmonious order.
One topic from among edicts, proclamations, and memorials [?].

title: 正德八年河南鄉試錄
text:
擬漢召河南守吳公爲廷尉詔〔文帝元年〕
擬唐以魏徵爲秘書監參預朝政誥〔貞觀三年〕
擬宋司馬光進稽古録表〔元祐元年〕
判語〔五條〕
無故不朝參公座
私剏庵院及私度僧道
公差人員欺陵長官
文書應給驛而不給
虛費功力採取不堪用
===
第叄場
策五道
問帝王之學尚矣堯舜禹授受之間告戒
數語而一心天日於是昭揭湯之建中
武之建極寔得於此湯武之後君不必
皆聖聖不必有位心學不傳而後孔子
傳之大學之書其言格物致知誠意以
正其心以爲脩身齊家治國平天下之
punctuated:
擬漢召河南守吳公爲廷尉詔〔文帝元年〕。
擬唐以魏徵爲秘書監、參預朝政誥〔貞觀三年〕。
擬宋司馬光進稽古録表〔元祐元年〕。
判語〔五條〕：
無故不朝參公座。
私剏庵院及私度僧道。
公差人員欺陵長官。
文書應給驛而不給。
虛費功力，採取不堪用。

第叄場
策五道
問：帝王之學尚矣。堯舜禹授受之間，告戒數語，而一心天日於是昭揭。湯之建中，武之建極，寔得於此。湯武之後，君不必皆聖，聖不必有位。心學不傳，而後孔子傳之《大學》之書，其言格物致知、誠意以正其心，以爲脩身齊家治國平天下之
translation_en:
Compose a simulated Han edict summoning Lord Wu, Governor of Henan, to serve as Commandant of Justice. 〔First year of Emperor Wen’s reign.〕
Compose a simulated Tang proclamation appointing Wei Zheng Director of the Palace Library, with participation in deliberations on court affairs. 〔Third year of Zhenguan.〕
Compose a simulated memorial by Sima Guang of the Song presenting his Record of Investigating Antiquity (Jigu lu). 〔First year of Yuanyou.〕
Legal judgments 〔five items〕:
Failure without cause to attend court audience or appear at an official sitting.
Unauthorized establishment of Buddhist convents or monasteries, and unauthorized ordination of Buddhist monks or Daoist priests.
Personnel on official assignments bullying their superior officials.
Failure to provide postal-relay service for documents entitled to it.
Wasteful expenditure of labor in procuring materials unfit for use.

Third Session
Five Policy Questions
Question: The learning of emperors and kings is ancient indeed. When Yao, Shun, and Yu transmitted and received the succession, their few words of admonition made the single heart shine forth like the sun in Heaven. Tang’s establishment of the Mean and King Wu’s establishment of the Supreme Standard truly derived from this. After Tang and Wu, rulers were not necessarily all sages, and sages did not necessarily occupy the throne. The learning of the heart ceased to be transmitted; afterward, Confucius transmitted it in the book the Great Learning. It speaks of investigating things and extending knowledge, and making one’s intentions sincere in order to rectify one’s heart, for the cultivation of oneself, the regulation of the family, the governance of the state, and the bringing of peace to all under Heaven …

title: 正德八年河南鄉試錄
text:
本以爲萬世法者至詳悉矣我
太宗文皇帝嗣承
高皇洪業思厥創造明昭有訓是儀是式以爲
作之於前不有以繼之於後無以承藉
悠久遂于
幾務之隙采古嘉言編爲聖學心法一書面
命心傳于
聖子神孫有綱有目有統言者有專言者篇目
之第具載
===
宸翰所序丹青炳煥累數千言而脩德保位序
未貽訓尤拳拳焉綱首君道目先學問
若心法之所指固有在也不知于堯舜
禹之所授受何所發明視孔氏大學之
所條列孰爲詳盡茲欲對揚
燕翼之謀仰贊危微之旨綱之所統言者在
今日以何爲要目之所專言者在今日
以何爲急諸士子潛心聖學有年願敬
陳之有司將轉而
punctuated:
本，以爲萬世法者，至詳悉矣。我太宗文皇帝嗣承高皇洪業，思厥創造，明昭有訓，是儀是式，以爲作之於前，不有以繼之於後，無以承藉悠久。遂于幾務之隙，采古嘉言，編爲《聖學心法》一書，面命心傳于聖子神孫。有綱有目，有統言者，有專言者，篇目之第具載宸翰所序，丹青炳煥，累數千言，而脩德保位，序未貽訓尤拳拳焉。
綱首君道，目先學問，若心法之所指，固有在也。不知于堯舜禹之所授受，何所發明？視孔氏《大學》之所條列，孰爲詳盡？茲欲對揚燕翼之謀，仰贊危微之旨，綱之所統言者，在今日以何爲要？目之所專言者，在今日以何爲急？諸士子潛心聖學有年，願敬陳之，有司將轉而
translation_en:
…as the foundation, establishing a standard for all ages: its exposition is most thorough and detailed. Our Emperor Taizong Wen inherited the great enterprise of Emperor Gao. Reflecting upon its founding, he set forth clear instructions to serve as patterns and models. He held that, unless what had been established by his predecessor was carried forward by his successors, there would be no means of sustaining that inheritance for the ages. Accordingly, in intervals between the myriad affairs of government, he gathered exemplary sayings from antiquity and compiled them into a book, Principles of the Mind in Sagely Learning (Shengxue xinfa), personally imparting its instructions and transmitting its teachings from heart to heart to his sagely sons and divine grandsons. It has major divisions and subordinate topics, some treating matters comprehensively and others addressing particular subjects. The sequence of its chapters is fully recorded in the preface written by the imperial hand. Resplendent in its literary colors, it runs to several thousand words; at the end of the preface [?], the instructions bequeathed concerning the cultivation of virtue and preservation of the throne are especially earnest.
The major divisions begin with the Way of the ruler, and the subordinate topics begin with learning and inquiry. It would seem that these principles of the mind have a definite purpose. What do they elucidate concerning the teachings transmitted from Yao to Shun and Yu? Compared with the matters set out in Confucius’s Great Learning, which treatment is more comprehensive? Now, wishing to honor and carry forward the plan for securing the welfare of posterity, and reverently to further the meaning of the teaching that the human mind is precarious and the mind of the Way subtle, we ask: among the matters treated comprehensively in the major divisions, what should be considered most essential today? Among the particular subjects addressed under the subordinate topics, what should be considered most urgent today? You candidates have devoted yourselves to sagely learning for many years. We ask you respectfully to set forth your views; the responsible officials will then transmit them onward …

title: 正德八年河南鄉試錄
text:
上聞以裨我
聖天子夙夜敬止之盛德非徒問也
問孔子曰吾未見剛者而孟子則曰我善
養吾浩然之氣夫天地之氣人所同得
養而充之固無難者而乃爲聖人所未
見惟孟子爲善養之其故何也戰國之
士固不必言聖門聰明才辨者不爲不
多乃卒無一剛者乎又况氣之所賦剛
柔異質必至於剛必至於浩然而後爲
===
此氣之充則夫沉靜愿慤之質其皆不
足以與此邪或以爲士氣之振靡由於
人主之好惡是故有周之士貴秦之士
賤之說然以嫚罵之時而乃有姗逆之
老驕息之俗而乃有挈揖之憤凡有志
者則亦何嘗拘於崇奬者之爲而謂氣
節之難邪或以爲天下之事惟有才氣
者能主張之是故有剛則不回柔則不
立之說然龍門風裁卒以成黨錮之□
punctuated:
上聞，以裨我聖天子夙夜敬止之盛德，非徒問也。
問：孔子曰：「吾未見剛者。」而孟子則曰：「我善養吾浩然之氣。」夫天地之氣，人所同得，養而充之，固無難者，而乃爲聖人所未見，惟孟子爲善養之，其故何也？戰國之士固不必言，聖門聰明才辨者不爲不多，乃卒無一剛者乎？又况氣之所賦，剛柔異質，必至於剛，必至於浩然，而後爲此氣之充，則夫沉靜愿慤之質，其皆不足以與此邪？或以爲士氣之振靡，由於人主之好惡，是故有周之士貴、秦之士賤之說。然以嫚罵之時，而乃有姗逆之老；驕息之俗，而乃有挈揖之憤。凡有志者，則亦何嘗拘於崇奬者之爲，而謂氣節之難邪？或以爲天下之事，惟有才氣者能主張之，是故有剛則不回、柔則不立之說。然龍門風裁，卒以成黨錮之□
translation_en:
…report it to the throne, thereby assisting our sagely Son of Heaven in his abundant virtue of maintaining reverence morning and night. This is no idle question.
Question: Confucius said, “I have never seen a person of firmness.” Yet Mengzi said, “I am good at nourishing my vast, flowing vital force.” The vital force of Heaven and Earth is something all people receive alike. Nourishing it and bringing it to fullness should surely present no difficulty. Yet the sage had never seen such a person, and Mengzi alone was good at nourishing it. Why was this? Leaving aside the men of the Warring States, there were certainly many intelligent, talented, and eloquent men in the sage’s school. Was there ultimately not a single firm person among them? Moreover, people are endowed with vital force in different constitutions, firm or yielding. If this force must attain firmness and vastness before it can be considered fully developed, are those of quiet, sincere, and honest disposition all incapable of sharing in it?
Some hold that the flourishing or decline of the spirit of scholars depends upon the ruler’s likes and dislikes. Hence the saying that scholars were honored under the Zhou and despised under the Qin. Yet even in an age of insulting abuse there were elders who resisted with scorn [?]; amid customs of arrogance and indolence [?], there was indignation expressed through lifting the hands in a salute [?]. When have men of resolve ever been constrained by the actions of those who confer honor and encouragement? Why, then, say that maintaining moral courage and integrity is difficult?
Some hold that only men of talent and spirit can take charge of the affairs of the realm. Hence the saying that the firm do not bend, while the yielding cannot stand. Yet the exacting moral bearing associated with Longmen ultimately brought about the proscription of partisans [illegible character]…

title: 正德八年河南鄉試錄
text:
伏闕抗言乃不免編管之禍則又何用
於激烈者之爲而謂氣之可集事邪諸
生皆豪傑有志者也其平居之所以善
養與其所以自任必有得於孔孟之家
法者矣試一言之亦今日學力之驗他
日遠到之地也
問諸子之能見道者在唐莫過於韓子而
諸儒之繼絕學者在宋莫先於周子韓
子當文氣卑弱之餘力起而扶之有謂
===
其識見之大千餘年後斷得分明其取
重如此今其文具在可以舉而論之乎
周子生於道喪千載聖遠言湮之餘有
謂其不由師傳默契道體今其書尚在
亦可以一論之乎然韓子文人也周子
大儒也韓之不可擬乎周人皆知之吾
亦安敢兩重而無拳衡之知哉特其所
以爲優劣者亦不可無從違之的而未
有舉其實而互論之焉原道以博愛爲
punctuated:
伏闕抗言，乃不免編管之禍，則又何用於激烈者之爲，而謂氣之可集事邪？諸生皆豪傑有志者也，其平居之所以善養，與其所以自任，必有得於孔孟之家法者矣。試一言之，亦今日學力之驗、他日遠到之地也。
問：諸子之能見道者，在唐莫過於韓子；而諸儒之繼絕學者，在宋莫先於周子。韓子當文氣卑弱之餘，力起而扶之。有謂其識見之大，千餘年後斷得分明，其取重如此。今其文具在，可以舉而論之乎？周子生於道喪千載、聖遠言湮之餘，有謂其不由師傳，默契道體。今其書尚在，亦可以一論之乎？然韓子文人也，周子大儒也。韓之不可擬乎周，人皆知之，吾亦安敢兩重而無拳衡之知哉？特其所以爲優劣者，亦不可無從違之的，而未有舉其實而互論之焉。《原道》以博愛爲
translation_en:
…Prostrating themselves before the palace gates and speaking out boldly, they nevertheless could not escape the calamity of compulsory residence under official supervision. What use, then, are impassioned actions, and how can one claim that spirited resolve can accomplish affairs? You candidates are all outstanding men of ambition. In how you properly nurture yourselves in everyday life and in the responsibilities you take upon yourselves, you must surely have gained something from the teachings handed down by Kongzi and Mengzi. Set this out briefly: it will both demonstrate your present attainments in learning and provide a foundation for far-reaching achievements in the future.
Question: Among the masters capable of discerning the Way, none in the Tang surpassed Master Han [Han Yu]; among the Confucian scholars who revived the interrupted tradition of learning, none in the Song preceded Master Zhou [Zhou Dunyi]. Master Han arose with determination to sustain literary vigor after it had fallen into weakness. Someone has said that, so great was his discernment, he could pass clear judgment more than a thousand years after the events. Such was the esteem in which he was held. His writings are now all available: can you cite and discuss them? Master Zhou was born after the Way had been lost for a thousand years, when the sages were remote and their words obscured. Someone has said that, without receiving instruction from a teacher, he tacitly apprehended the substance of the Way. His writings too survive: can you also discuss them? Yet Master Han was a man of letters, while Master Zhou was a great Confucian scholar. Everyone knows that Han cannot be ranked with Zhou. How, then, could I dare esteem both equally without knowing how to weigh their merits [?]? Still, in determining their relative merits, there must be a standard for what to accept and reject; yet no one has brought forward the actual evidence and discussed them in comparison. In his Inquiry into the Way (Yuan dao), Han takes universal love to be…

title: 正德八年河南鄉試錄
text:
仁謂其遺體而愛曰仁之說不同是病
邪言誠正而不言格致謂其無本而守
貴行利之說恐亦未之及也原性論上
中下三品彼剛柔善惡中之說非其遺
意乎原鬼謂無形聲與氣彼神妙萬物
之說非其遺旨乎夫以其言之大畧相
當如此則固無優劣之可言而謂韓之
不可儗乎周益又甚矣將所以優者乃
在於人而不在於言乎幸為我一辨之
===
問養士必於學校取士必以貢舉此古今
之通制也我
國家百四十年以來所與共圖治理者亦惟
建學設科以待天下之才耳然學校者
教士之本原貢舉者選士之要法以學
校言之有不毀鄉校者有未遑庠序者
何所見不同歟抑不知不毀者果用之
以養士而未遑者又將養士於何地也
以貢舉言之有別立制舉者有專於文
punctuated:
仁，謂其遺體，而愛曰仁之說不同，是病邪？言誠正而不言格致，謂其無本，而守貴行利之說恐亦未之及也。《原性》論上中下三品，彼剛柔善惡中之說，非其遺意乎？《原鬼》謂無形聲與氣，彼神妙萬物之說，非其遺旨乎？夫以其言之大畧相當如此，則固無優劣之可言，而謂韓之不可儗乎周，益又甚矣。將所以優者乃在於人，而不在於言乎？幸為我一辨之。
問：養士必於學校，取士必以貢舉，此古今之通制也。我國家百四十年以來，所與共圖治理者，亦惟建學設科以待天下之才耳。然學校者，教士之本原；貢舉者，選士之要法。以學校言之，有不毀鄉校者，有未遑庠序者，何所見不同歟？抑不知不毀者果用之以養士，而未遑者又將養士於何地也？以貢舉言之，有別立制舉者，有專於文
translation_en:
…benevolence: it is said that he omits its underlying substance. Yet how does this differ from the statement that “love is called benevolence”? Is this a fault? He speaks of making the intentions sincere and rectifying the mind without mentioning investigating things and extending knowledge, and is therefore said to lack a foundation. Yet the statement about “valuing what one holds to and benefiting through action” [?] may likewise fail to reach this point. On Human Nature (Yuan xing) discusses the three grades—upper, middle, and lower. Does the other account, concerning firmness and yielding, goodness and evil, and the mean, not preserve his underlying meaning? On Ghosts (Yuan gui) speaks of the absence of form, sound, and vital energy. Does the other statement, that spiritual efficacy wondrously works through the myriad things, not preserve his underlying purport? Since their statements broadly correspond in this way, there is surely no superiority or inferiority to speak of; to assert that Han Yu cannot be compared with Zhou Dunyi is all the more excessive. Can it be that the superiority lies in the person rather than in his words? Kindly distinguish these matters for me.
Question: Scholars must be educated in schools and selected through the tribute examination system: this has been the common institution from antiquity to the present. For the past one hundred and forty years, our dynasty has sought men with whom to pursue good government simply by establishing schools and instituting examinations to receive the talented men of the realm. Schools are the foundation for educating scholars; the tribute examination system is the essential method for selecting them. As regards schools, some refused to demolish the local schools, while others had no leisure to attend to educational institutions. Why did their views differ? Moreover, did those who refused to demolish them actually use them to educate scholars? And where did those who had no leisure for schools intend to educate scholars? As regards the tribute examination system, some separately established special examinations by imperial decree, while others concentrated on literary…

title: 正德八年河南鄉試錄
text:
藝者何立法不一歟抑不知制舉者果
取之於鄉校而文藝者又將取之於何
學也夫士養於學校則行業專而資用
之材博其不由學校而出者亦有用世
之效否邪起於貢舉則趨向正而僥倖
之途塞其不由貢舉而起者亦有不壞
士習者否邪茲欲廣育才之方盡取才
之法以裨當世之用正
今日急務也諸士子幸折衷往昔悉所見以對
===
問時務之急非一今日之所當議若兵與
食尤其不可缺也河南山東流賊之害
始息而江西暨川蜀諸郡亡命之亂未
殄數年間典兵戎者動以單弱上
聞職供餉者每爲匱乏之
請事付
廷議蓋嘗發
禁兵矣調邊兵矣又令調土軍矣嘗給
內帑矣借邊儲矣又開輸粟納銀納馬例矣
punctuated:
藝者，何立法不一歟？抑不知制舉者果取之於鄉校，而文藝者又將取之於何學也？夫士養於學校，則行業專而資用之材博，其不由學校而出者，亦有用世之效否邪？起於貢舉，則趨向正而僥倖之途塞，其不由貢舉而起者，亦有不壞士習者否邪？茲欲廣育才之方，盡取才之法，以裨當世之用，正今日急務也。諸士子幸折衷往昔，悉所見以對。

問：時務之急非一，今日之所當議，若兵與食，尤其不可缺也。河南、山東流賊之害始息，而江西暨川蜀諸郡亡命之亂未殄。數年間，典兵戎者動以單弱上聞，職供餉者每爲匱乏之請。事付廷議，蓋嘗發禁兵矣，調邊兵矣，又令調土軍矣；嘗給內帑矣，借邊儲矣，又開輸粟、納銀、納馬例矣。
translation_en:
…literary accomplishment. Why did the regulations they established differ? Yet we do not know whether those who held special examinations actually recruited from local schools; and from what schools did those who emphasized literary accomplishment recruit? When scholars are nurtured in schools, their conduct and studies become focused, and the pool of talent available for service becomes broad. Have those who emerged outside the schools likewise proved effective in serving the world? When scholars advance through the examination system, their aspirations are properly directed and avenues of advancement by mere luck are closed. Have those who advanced outside that system likewise avoided corrupting the ethos of scholars? To broaden the means of nurturing talent and fully employ the methods of recruiting it, thereby meeting the needs of the present age, is precisely the urgent task of today. You candidates should weigh past precedents and set forth your views in full in your replies.

Question: There is more than one pressing matter of current affairs. Among those that ought to be discussed today, troops and provisions are especially indispensable. The ravages of roving bandits in Henan and Shandong have only just subsided, while uprisings by outlaws in Jiangxi and the various prefectures of Sichuan have not yet been quelled. In recent years, those commanding troops have repeatedly reported to the throne that their forces are too few and weak, while those charged with supplying military provisions have repeatedly appealed for relief from shortages. These matters have been referred for court deliberation. Palace troops have already been dispatched, frontier troops transferred, and orders also issued to transfer native troops. Funds have already been provided from the imperial treasury, frontier reserves borrowed, and regulations also introduced allowing contributions of grain, silver, and horses…

title: 正德八年河南鄉試錄
text:
憂貽
宵旰事出權宜老成于此甚非其得已也
國家承平日久休養生息不爲不至而所在
地方一遇警急輙弗自支吾不知府衛
平素之所訓練而赳赳稱武者置於何
地田賦往昔之所征斂而陳陳相因者
積於何所居重馭輕國之大勢顧此失
彼人之通患而不虞之變代不能無苟
事往而弗圖將事至而無措
===
禁兵其可常發邊兵其可常調而土軍之獷
悍其可常用乎
内帑其可常給邊儲其可常借而輸納之例
其可常開乎夫安不忘危慮當及遠一
之已甚再必難繼茲欲增壯丁以助戎
行之不足而或者病其妨農欲清屯地
以補稅額之舊逋而或者議其厲衆善
後之計當何所從識時務者在俊傑諸
士子以俊傑而自待者矧足食足兵孔
punctuated:
憂貽宵旰，事出權宜，老成于此，甚非其得已也。國家承平日久，休養生息，不爲不至，而所在地方一遇警急，輙弗自支。吾不知府衛平素之所訓練而赳赳稱武者，置於何地？田賦往昔之所征斂而陳陳相因者，積於何所？居重馭輕，國之大勢；顧此失彼，人之通患。而不虞之變，代不能無。苟事往而弗圖，將事至而無措。
禁兵其可常發，邊兵其可常調，而土軍之獷悍，其可常用乎？内帑其可常給，邊儲其可常借，而輸納之例，其可常開乎？夫安不忘危，慮當及遠。一之已甚，再必難繼。茲欲增壯丁以助戎行之不足，而或者病其妨農；欲清屯地以補稅額之舊逋，而或者議其厲衆。善後之計，當何所從？識時務者在俊傑，諸士子以俊傑而自待者，矧足食足兵，孔
translation_en:
…These troubles have burdened the emperor, who rises before dawn and eats only after dark; the measures taken have been expedients. Even seasoned statesmen have resorted to them only because they had no alternative. The state has long enjoyed peace, and its efforts to allow the people to recuperate and prosper have certainly been thorough. Yet whenever an emergency arises, the locality concerned cannot sustain itself. I do not know where the men regularly trained by the prefectures and military guards, acclaimed as valiant warriors, have been stationed. Where have the land-tax revenues collected in former years, supposedly accumulating year upon year, been stored? Maintaining strength at the center to control the less powerful periphery is the broad configuration of the state; attending to one thing while neglecting another is a common human failing. Yet no age can be free of unforeseen upheavals. If we fail to make plans once an incident has passed, we shall have no measures ready when another arrives.
Can the imperial troops be dispatched continually, or the frontier troops repeatedly redeployed? Can fierce and unruly native troops be employed time after time? Can funds continually be supplied from the Privy Treasury, or borrowed from frontier reserves? Can the provisions for contributions of grain, silver, and horses be opened repeatedly? In peace, one must not forget danger; one's deliberations must reach far ahead. To do this once is already excessive; a second time will surely be difficult to sustain. We now wish to recruit more able-bodied men to remedy the shortage in the ranks, but some object that this would interfere with farming. We wish to investigate and regularize military-colony lands to make up longstanding arrears in the tax quota, but some argue that this would distress the people. What course, then, should we follow in planning for the aftermath? It is outstanding men who understand the needs of the times, and you candidates regard yourselves as such men. Moreover, concerning sufficient food and sufficient troops, Confucius…

title: 正德八年河南鄉試錄
text: 氏有訓幸毋忝我告焉
punctuated: 氏有訓，幸毋忝我告焉。
translation_en: …Master Kong has given instruction on this. I trust you will not fail to do justice to my exhortation.

第二十三名張儒南陽府學生詩
第二十四名劉可羅山縣學生春秋
第二十五名羅玶扶溝縣學生書
===
第二十六名賈汝淮臨潁縣學生詩
